tei:div.tei:p: (419)bla ma mchaud pa'i cho ga tshogs gnyis shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ (420)

oṃ swā sti sid+dhi/ tshogs gnyis sa gzhir rnam grol dpag bsam shing*/ mtha' yas yon tan me tog 'bras bkra zhing*/ phan bde'i grib bsil srid zhi'i dbyings kun khyab/ rgyal ba'i byang chub ljon shing la phyag 'tshal/ 'di ltar lam 'bras ma nor legs pa'i lam/ dam pa rnams la brten las legs par 'byung*/ dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas nyan rang tshogs/ byang chub gsum brnyes dge ba'i bshes las byung*/ srid na mngon mtho bde ba'i shas thob pa/ (421) de yang dam pa ga la brten nas 'byung*/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin dge ba'i bshes gnyen brten par gdams pa la/ rang bzhin bsam pa dang*/ rnal 'byor bsgom pa gnyis las/ dngos la khyad par bsam pa dang*/ mtshan nyid brtags pa/ yon tan bsngags pa gsum las/ dam pa dang dam pa ma yin pa'i khyad par bla dor bya ba ni/ yang dag 'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen brten pa de'i yon tan dge ba dang legs pa ngang gis 'go ba ni tsan+da gyi shing drung du 'khod na dri zhim po'i da 'go ba lta (422) bu dang*/ de yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang dge ba'i grogs po brten par bya ste/ bdag gi dge ba gong nas gang du 'phel zhing rgyas par byed pa'i phyir ro/ mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen ngan pa dang sdig pa'i grogs po brten na de'i nyes skyon ngang gis 'go ba ni mi gtsang ba'i khrod dang*/ ku sha nya tul gyis bgos pa lta bu'o/ de'i phyir bdag gis sdig pa'i bshes gnyen grogs dang bcas pa spang dgos te mi dge ba'i phyogs srab zhing spang nas med par bya dgos pa'i phyir ro snyam du/ dang po skyon yon la bsam par bya'o/ de nas mtshan nyid brtags pa la gnyis/ thun mong gi mtshan nyid ni/ nor bu'i gling du 'khrid pa ni ded dpon mkhas pa'i rang bzhin can la rag las pa ltar bdag gis thar pa'i gling du phyin nas (423) sangs rgyas thob pa'ang dge ba'i bshes gnye la rag las pas/ sku gsung thugs kyi spyod pa skyon med cing yon tan phun sum tshogs pas brgyan pa/

thos pa dang snying rje che ba/ tshad med pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rjes mnga' bas 'brel tshad thar pa'i lam la 'god pa/ skyo dbu dang dka' thub bzod pa gcig la brten par bya/ thun mong ma yin pa ni tshe 'dir dngos su mda' ris dbang phyug phun tshogs pa sbyin pa 'khor los bsgyur ba la sogs pa rgyal po bzang po ma rag las pa ltar/ bdag gis kyang tshe gcig gis bla na med pa'i 'bras bu dang yon tan thob pa la bla ma rdo rje 'jin pa mkhas grub dam pa la rag las pas/ (424) bla ma dam pa dbang dang dam tshig phan tshogs pa rgyud dang man ngag gi gnas la mkhas pa/ bsnyen sgrub zab mo'i nus pa thon pa/ lta dgongs ting nge 'jin gyi gdeng tshad dang ldan pa/ gzhan don phrin las phun tshogs pa gcig brtan dgos/ yon tan bsngags pa la rim pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ 'jig rten na u dum wa ri'i me tog 'byung bar dka' ba ltar sangs rgyas 'byung bar dka' ba ltar sangs rgyas 'byung dka'/ de'i thugs rje las sprul pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa'ang 'byung dka' ste/ da res bdag cag gi dpal mgon bla ma dam pa 'dis mtshon nas yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la yon tan tshad med pa mnga' ba ni/ srid pa'i rgya (425) mtsho sgrol bas gru chen mnyan pa lta bu/ thar ba'i lam sna 'dren pas ded da pon mkhas pa lta bu/ srid zhi'i rgud pa sel bas yid bzhin nor bu lta bu/ nyon mongs me dpung 'jil bas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun lta bu/ chos kyi char chen 'bebs pas char sprin bzang po lta bu/ 'gro kun dga' ba bskyed pas lha'i rnga lta bu/ dug gsum nad kun sel ba sman pa'i rgyal po lta bu/ ma rig mun pa sel bas nyi zla'i sgron me lta bu/ 'dod dgu'i re ba 'bayung bas dpag bsam shing chen lta bu/ phrin las 'od stong 'phro ba nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bu'i yon tan mnga' ba sta bdag kyang nam zhig na de kho na 'dra ba thob par shog skam du

(426) bsam/ gnyis pa 'di ltar bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa rnams kyi dgongs pa nam mkha' ltar rgya che/ yon tan gter mjod ltar lhun grub/ 'jig rten na rgyal ba ltar yongs su 'dren pa'i rang bzhin dam pa ste/ yon tan re re'i tsha yang bdag gis me long bas ngo mtshar rtag tu dgyes shing thugs rjes 'jin par shog snyam du bsam/ gsum pa 'di ltar dpal mgon bla ma dam pa rnams ni mthong ba dang thos pa dran pa dang reg pa tsam gyis thar pa'i sa bon 'debs shing 'khor ba phyir bsnyil bas sangs rgyas kun dang phrin las kyi byed pa gcig pa dang*/ thar ba'i lam du 'dren pas skal ba mchog tu gyur pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gang du he ru ka'i ngo bor dbang rdzogs (427) thams cad kyi bya ba byed pas dkon mchog bzhi par bya'o/ gdul bya'i ngor sangs rgyas las kyang bka' drin mchog tu che ba'i yon tan mnga' ba ste/ tshe 'dir smin sgrol zab mo'i lam la 'god pa'i ngang tshul can rnams la tshe rabs thams cad du bsten zhing mnyes nas thugs rjes 'jin pa shog snyam pa'o/ gnyis pa rnal 'byor bsgom pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba la gsum/ dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar gdan seng ge dang pad+ma rin po che'i steng du bla ma dang sangs rgyas dbyer med du bzhugs pa la/ byang chub (428)sems dpa'i tshogs dang mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtshos bskor ba mkha' khyab tu sad par bsam la/ bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ zhes ci 'grub brjod pa'i rjes/ bdag dang sems can thams cad dkon mchog gsum la thim/ de yang blal ma sangs rgyas rin po che la thim/ de yang chos sku spros bral stong pa'i ngang du (429)thim pas gang yang dmigs su med pa'i ngang la blo lhod nas mnyam par bzhag go gnyis pa tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pa la yang phan yon bsam pa ni/

byams pas ni gnas skabs kun tu yid du 'ong zhing mthar thug chos sku 'grub pa dang*/ snying rjes 'tshe ba med cing longs sku 'grub pa dang*/ dga' bas phrag dog med cing sprul sku 'grub pa dang*/ btang snyoms kyis sems las su rung ba'i ngo bo nyid sku 'grub pas/ byams pa'i dmigs yul sems can bde ba dang mi ldan pa thams cad rnam pa bde ba dang ldan par 'dod pas/ ma nam mkha' dang (430)mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig ces bsgom/ snying rje'i dmigs yul sdug bsngal drag pos gdung pa la rnam pa bral 'dod kyi blo shas mi bzod pa cig bsgom la/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar shog zhes bsgom/ dga' ba'i dmigs yul ni mtho ris kyi yul na gang su zhig bde zhing skyid pa che chung ci yod pa nas/ bde ba dang bde ba'i cha yul du byas te rnam pa de dang mi 'bral bar 'dod pas/ ma nam mkha' (431)dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dam pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig zhes bsgom/ btang snyoms ni dus gsum du brtags na dgra gnyen du 'gyur ba nges pa med pa'i phyir rang phyogs la chags gzhan phyogs la rang ba'i sems kyis dgra gnyen ngo mnyam du brtags la/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la rab tu gnas par gyur cig snyam du bsgom/ (432) gsum pa byang chub tu sems bskyed pa ni/ rten gyi drung du thal mo sbyar te bdag gis sems can gyi don du byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas spyod pa rlabs po che la bslab cing 'khor ba na sems can gcig kyang mi gnas pa de tsam brtson 'grus brtsam snyam nas tshig gi rgyal po 'di dag brjod par bya'o/ bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba dus 'di nas snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du/

bla ma rdo rje 'jin pa chen po rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas bcom ldan (433)'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ zhi ba 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ tshogs rnams kyi mchog 'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ bdag byang chub sems dpar rjes su bzung du gsaul/ bla ma rdo rje 'jin pa chen po rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang*/ (434)sa chen po la bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang*/ sa chen po la bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis sems can thams cad kyi don du byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung ste/ snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du sems can thams (435)cad kyi don du byang chub chen por sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ sems can ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o/ ma grol ba rnams grol bar bgyi'o/ dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o/ yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bgyi'o/ zhes lan gsum brjod do/ de nas don dam pa'i sems bskyed pa ni/ 'di ltar med bzhin du snang ba'i cha nas/ sgyu ma'i tshul du skye sogs snang ngan yang*/ snang (436) dus nyid nas skye sogs rang bzhin med pa chu'i zla ba dang*/ rmig rgyu'i chu ltar skye bar snang dus nyid nas skye ba med pa la sogs par bltas te/ e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang*/ skye ba med las thams cad skye/ skyes pa nyid na skye ba med/ e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang*/ 'gags pa med las thams cad 'gags/ 'gags pa nyid na 'gags pa med/

e ma'o (437)ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang*/ gnas pa med las thams cad gnas/ gnas pa nyid na gnas pa med/ e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang*/ dmigs pa med las thams cad dmigs/ dmigs pa nyid na dmigs pa med/ e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang*/ 'gro 'ong med (438)las 'gro dang 'ong*/ 'gro 'ong nyid na 'gro 'ong med/ bzhi pa dngos grub gyi gegs bla ma dang mchod grogs gang la mkhon pa de spyi bor bsgom la rab tu 'gyed de mchi ma 'byin zhing thal mo sbyar te/ kyai kyai bla ma rin po che/ bdag la res gzhan na med/ thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs su gsol/ ma rig 'khrul pas bdag non te/ sgo gsum nyes pa ci mchis pa/ rab tu 'gyod pas bshags par bgyi/ sdom pa gsum dang 'gal gyur cing*/ (439)nyes pa'i dri mas sems dgos pa/ de kun khyed kyi thugs rje yis/ skad cig nyid la byang bar mjod/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis/ ma 'tshal bzhin du sdig bgyis pas/ sngar yang 'khor bar rab tu 'khyams/ da ni bla ma thugs rje can/ khyod kyis bdag gi sgrib pa kun/ skad cig nyid la byang bar mjod/ 'di ltar mi shes byis pa la/ skyon gyur mthong tshe lhag par yang*/ (440)thugs rjes gzigs pa mi 'jug na/ de las gzhan la cir 'gyur dgongs/ bu yi nyes pa gang lags pa/ ma yis sel zhing skyobs ba ltar/ bdag cag 'gro drug sems can la/ khyed kyis dang por thugs bskyed nas/ phan pa mjad ces dam bcas na/ dus 'dir bdag la cis mi dgongs/ bdag cag 'khrul pa'i sems can la/ gzigs nas thugs rjes mi 'jin na/ khyod kyi phrin las (441)gdul bya la/ phan pa de yang ci ltar dgongs/ sngon gyi rgyal ba grags med kyang*/ bdag cag spang nas thar par gshegs/ da ni phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yis/ khyod la bskul nas bdag cag gi

don du bla mar rnam sprul nas/ khyod kyis bdag cag 'dor phod dam/ 'jigs par skyel mas bslus pa bzhin/ khyod kyis de ring bslu mjad dam/ yid bzhin nor bu rin chen yang*/ (442)gsol ba btab na 'dod dgu 'byin/ khyed ni brtse chen thabs la mkhas/ ci'i phyir bdag la rjes mi gzigs/ sha za rnams kyang mchod sbyin dang*/ bden pa'i tshig ni brjod ma thag sngon gyi khro ba'ang 'dor bgyid na/ khyed ni brtse chen 'gro ba'i yab/ gus mchod gdung bas sems gdungs shing*/ nyes pa bshags na cis mi gzigs/ bdag gi sdig kun ma byang bar/ skye ba gzhan du song gyur (443)na/ dmyal mes bsreg pa kho nar zad/ de la khyod kyis mi gzigs na/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid ji ltar lags/ kye ma kyi hud bdag gi sdig ma lus byang bar mjad du gsol/ skad cig 'di la thugs rjes dgongs/ bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs/ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol/ tshe 'dir bsam pa kun (444)'grub cing*/ 'chi khar gnad gcod sdug bsngal med/ bar do'i 'jigs pa kun las sgrol/ 'og min gnas su 'khrid par mjod/ ces nyin mtshan thun bzhir gsol ba gdab/ des ni nyams chag thams cad dag nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub myur du thob po/ nyams chag skong ba la 'di las zab pa'i gnad med do/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la rang nyid yi dag gang mos su sgom par gsungs pas 'di la gnyis kyi bdag dam tshig par gsal ba dang*/ tshogs zhing dngos sgom pa'o/ dang po la rten gzhal yas khang gsal ba ni/ (445)hūm̐/ bsam du med de chos dbyings nam mkha' che/ chos dbyings nam mkha' bsam pa kun dang bral/ bsam du med pa'i chos dbyings nam mkha' ni/ nam mkha' mi dmigs pa yang dmigs su med/ ces/ de'ang chos sku'i ngang nas gzugs sku 'char ba'i rten 'brel mngon du bya ba dang*/ 'di man chad kyis bskyed pa thams cad ye stong rdzogs pa chen pas zin pas dngos po dang mtshan mar zhen pa'i mdud pa las grol ba'i dgos pa yod do/

de nas stong pa mtha' gcig du zhen pa'i rtog pa (446) dgrol phyir kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'jin bsgom pa ni/ hūm̐/ rang rig rgyal po goms pa yis/ byang chub mchog 'di rnyed par 'gyur/ de phyir mthong rjes de bzhin nyid/ snying rje 'byung ba'i gzhi ru bzhag go rim 'byung ba'ang de bzhin no/ zhes chos thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa snying rje sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang nas rang rig pa rang byung gi ye shes gsal la 'jin pa med pa'ang dar gcig bsgom ste/ hūm̐/ chos rnams thams cad stong zhing bdag med dbyings/ rang bzhin spros dang bral ba'i ngang nyid (447)las/ hūm̐ las steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad du bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shig rgya che ba/ rtsibs bcu khro bo bcu yis mtshan pa ste/ phyi nang me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na gsal/ de yang bh+rūm̐ las srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba rtsibs bcu mu khyud lte ba dang bcas pa'i khog pa stong pa chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i rtsibs nang bcu la pad nyi zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ bcu yongs su gyur pa las khro bo bcu gsal ba'i 'khor lo'i lte bar 'od gsal ba'i sems nyid la zhing khams dang gzhal yas khang

(448) pa'i bkod pa ci yod pa de nyid kun tu bzang po'i bzhugs gnas yin pas 'dir de bskyed pas na kun tu bzang po'i dkyil 'khor ste/ de'ang tshe khyad nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa bsgom pa ni/ bh+rūm̐/ yid kyi nam mkha' la/ 'byung chen brtsegs par lhun gyis grub/ de steng rin chen sna bzhi las/ lhun gyis grub pa tshad dpag med/ de la brten pa'i sa gzhi ni/ rin chen sna tshogs gcal du bkram/ mnan nem btegs 'phar mjes pa'i gzhi/ de la pho brang gzhal (449)yas khang*/ gru bzhi lham pa mjes par snang*/ rin chen sna bzhi'i rgyu las grub/ glo 'bur bzhi yang mkhar thabs tshul/ rin chen bzhi las grub pa'o/ bum pa'i rtse mo chos kyi tog rma bya'i mdangs ltar bkra ba'o/ sgo bzhi sgo khyud rnams kyis brgyan/ rta babs brgyad dang yang dag ldan/ dbus na 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa/ lte bar bcas shing rtsibs rten ldan/ gru chad bar (450)khyams mjes par 'bar/ rin chen 'od zer 'bar bas 'khyil/ sems can pad+ma nyi zla dang*/ rin chen 'bar ba'i gdan mchog ldan/ rin chen khri rkang rnam rten mjes/ pho brang de yi rgyan mchog kyang*/ nyi zla nor bu rin chen 'bar/ bla bre rgyal mtshan na bza' gdugs/ dar dang do shal mu tig phreng*/ dril bu dang ni rnga yab sogs/ rol mo'i cha byad sna tshogs brgyan/ 'jig rten lha tshogs (451)mjes pa dang*/ de la sogs te rgyan rnams kyang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab mtha' yas mchog gzhal yas de yi sgo bzhi na/ glang chen rnams kyis mjes par byas/ rta babs rnams kyi tsong tsong la/ gser gyi dril bu 'bar ba dag dkon mchog gsum gyi mtshan yang sgrogs/ sgo drung de dag re re na/ tā la'i skye shing tso tsong bral/ dri dang gzugs dang 'od dang ldan/ tā la'i skye shing (452)de dag la/ khu byug la sogs bkra shis pa'i/ bya rnams snyan pa'i skad kyang sgrogs/ sgo drung de dag re re na/

khrus kyi rdzing bu dbyibs legs pa/ bro mchog yan lag brgyad ldan chu/ grangs med de dag re re na/ lha dang lha mo bsam mi khyab/ phyi rol kho ra 'khor yug na/ rtse sa 'chags pa brjod mi long*/ de la sogs te bsam yas mchog ma btsal ye nas lhun gyis grub/ de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor yang gzhi sems can (453) thams cad la ye nas de ltar gnas pas/ lam dang 'bras bu'i byang chub gyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu so bdun gyi yonatan gyi ngo bor rnam par dag pa'o/ pho brang de na gnas pa yi/ ye shes lha tshogs mang po rnams/ gtso gzungs zung du 'brel ba ste/ dbus kyi pho brang snying po la/ rnam par snang mjad phyag rgya che/ in+d+ra nī la'i kha dog 'dra/ rang rtags phyag na 'khor lo bsnams/ dpa' bo de yi spyan snga na/ rdo rje sems dpa' rgya che yang*/ (454)dung dang shel gyi kha dog 'dra/ rang rtags phyag na rdo rje 'jin/ g.yas na rin chen 'byung ldan gtso/ 'jam bu nā da'i kha dog can/ rang rtags rin chen zur brgyad 'jin/ rgyab na snang ba mtha' yas gtso/ pad+ma rā ga'i mdog 'dra zhing*/ rang rtags pad+ma dmar po 'jin/ g.yon du don yod grub pa ste/ in+d+ra nī la'i mdog lta bu/ rang rtags phyag na ral gri 'jin/ kun kyang zhi ba'i cha (455)lugs te/ thor tshugs rigs lngas kun la brgyan/ rdzogs pa'i skyil mo krung du bzhugs/ do shal dpung rgyan se mo de/ phyag gdub snyan chas kun nas mjes/ mtshan dang dpe byad yang dag rdzogs/ de dag gi ni g.yon rol na/ kun tu bzang mo lo tsa ni/ mā ma gos dkar sgrol ma rnams/ g.yas pa thams cad kyi gtso la 'khyud/ g.yon pas rang rtags dril bu 'jin/ cha (456)lugs gzhan rnams yab dang 'dra/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs la lhun gyis grub/ spyan snga'i glo 'bur mjes pa la/ lag na rdo rje sngo skya'i mdog rang rtags rdo rje rtse gsum mo/ g.yas na sa yi snying po ste/ ljang sngon rin chen myu gu 'jin/

rgyab tu nam mkha'i snying po ste/ mthing kha rang rtags ral gri 'jin/ g.yon na mjes pa'i glo 'bur la/ spyan ras gzigs dbang dmar skya ste/ rang rtags pad+ma (457)dkar po 'jin/ thor tshugs ye shes sems dpas brgyan/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung du bzhugs/ rgyan dang cha lugs kun gyis brgyan/ de dag gi ni g.yon rol na/ gar dang sgegs mo phreng ba dbyangs/ g.yas pa thabs kyis gtso la 'khyud/ g.yon pas gar dang me long phreng*/ pi waṃ 'jin cing cha lugs gzhan/ gtso bo nyid dang mthun pa yin/ mjes pa'i gru chad rnams (458)la ni/ byams pa mai tri dkar po ste/ mjes pa'i klu shing gan+dhe 'jin/ shar lho mtshams kyi gru chad la'o/ sgrib pa rnam sel mthing kha ste/ chos kyi 'khor lo 'jin pa ni/ lho nub mtshams su mjes par gnas/ 'jam dpal gzhon nu dmar skya'i mdog rang rtags ut+pal ral gri 'jin/ nub byang mtshams su mjes par gnas/ kun tu bzang po ljang ser mdog rang rtags rin chen snye ma (459)'jin/ byang shar mtshams kyi gru la gnas/ de dag gi ni g.yon rol na/ spos dang me tog mar me dri/ g.yas pa thabs kyi gtso la 'khyud/ g.yon pa rang rtags 'jin pa'o/ cha lugs dag kyang gong ma bzhin/ sgo khyud bzhi la 'joms pa bzhi/ gshin rje gshed po mthing nag 'bar/ nri mgo gdeng pa'i lag cha thogs/ shar gyi sgor ni rnam par gnas/ rnam par rgyal (460)ba ser nag 'bar/ rdo rjes gnon pa lho sgor ro/ rta mchog dmar nag 'bar ba ste/ thod sbrul thogs pa nub sgor gnas/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang nag 'bar/ rgya gram gyis gnon byang gi sgor/ stangs stabs tshul du rab tu gnas/ dur khrod rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ rnam par gtsigs gtsigs 'jigs 'jigs ltar/ me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na 'khyil/ hūm̐ dang phaṭa gyi sgra chen sgrogs/ de dag gi (461)ni g.yon rol na/ gshed mo dang ni rgyal byed ma/ rta mgrin me dang 'khyil mo rnams/

lag mtshon lcags kyu zhags pa dang*/ lcags sgrogs dril bu thogs shing rngams/ cha lugs 'joms pa dag dang 'dra/ sgo khyud dag tu lhun gyis grub/ mjes pa'i bar khyams de nyid la/ sprul sku thub pa chen po drug ces 'dul thabs kyis skur ston pa/ cha lugs ma nges 'dul bar ston/ (462)mjes pa'i bar khyams pa de nyid la/ mdun dang rgyab gyi phyogs rol tu/ byed pa po dang bya ba mo/ nam mkha' yi ni mdog 'dra ba/ ting nge 'jin du ldan par gnas/ de la sogs te bsam yas mchog brjod med brjod du med pa yi/ lha yi tshogs kyis gang bar gnas/ dkyil 'khor bsam yas lhun gyis grub/ lha yi tshogs mchacod de dag gi thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' gnas/ tshon gang (463)'od dang bcas pa'o/ ljags la rang rtags yi ge rnams/ rang rtags phyag rgya'i steng du gnas/ de lta'i sku mchog re re yang*/ tshul dgu dag dang ldan pa ste/ mnyen dang lcugs dang 'khril bag dang*/ ldem bag chags dang gzhon tshul can/ gsal dang 'tsher dang lhun stug dang*/ gzi byin 'bar bar rab tu gnas/ de lta'i rang bzhin dkyil 'khor gsal/ zhes lha'i dag pa ni phung po lnga (464) rnam par dag pa rigs lnga snang stong gi yab yum tu gsal ba dang*/ dbang shes dag pa sems dpa' brgyad/ yul dus dag pa sems ma brgyad/ reg yul dag pa sgo ba yab yum/ nyon mongs drug dag pa thub pa drug kun gzhi dang kun gzhi'i rnam shes dag pa kun bzang yab yum ste/ mdor na lha thams cad da lta kun gzhi las gyes pa'i rnam par shes pa'i tshogs dbang po yul dang bcas gnas su dag pa ltar gsal ba'o/ gnyis pa tshogs bsags pa'i zhing dngos bsgom pa ni/ de ltar bdag nyid kyi phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad sgyu 'phrul drwa ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor du rnam par dag pa'i spyi bor pad+ma (465)dmar po 'dab ma 'bum phrag brdal ba ze'u phor dmar ser du 'tsher ba'i nang khong thams cad rang bzhin gyi byin rlabs las/

steng dang 'og dang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten ma yin zhing bde ba'i zhing 'od zer lnga'i dra ba dang*/ zhing khams kyi thig les 'brel bas khyab par khebs pa'i dbus su seng ge chen po brgyad kyis spras pa'i rin po che'i khri rgyan dang bkod pa phun sum tshogs par thabs dang shes (466)rab gnyis su med pa'i nyi ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rab tu rgyas pa'i steng du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyis bsdus pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rtsa ba gsum gyi khyab bdag gdod ma'i mgon po drin chen rtsal ba'i bla ma lung rtogs bstan pa'i nyi ma 'od gsal rin chen snying po pad+ma las 'brel rtsal o rgyan tshe dbang rig 'jin dang kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po dbyer med pa ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bde bar gshegs pa mar me ri rab rgyal mtshan sku snang la rang bzhin med pa/ (467)ye shes kyi zhal phyag dang mkhyen pa yongs su rdzogs pa mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa sku las 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phro ba'i khong song du sprul pa'i zhing khams mang po yas man du rin po che'i gdugs rnam par brtsegs pa'i rnam pa/ phan tshun du 'bras bu'i phung po bkram pa lta bu'i zhing na sangs rgyas kyi sku 'bum phrag phrag khrig (468)dpag tu med pa brjod kyis mi lang ba rnams mthong ba rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor la mngon par snang ba/ zhal kun tu thal ler gsal ba mdun dang rgyab gyi phyogs mi dmigs pa dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can rdo rje 'chang gi cha lugs su bzhugs pa'i g.yas rol du chos kyi sku'i bstan pa dngos rang bzhin chos nyid kyi rdo rje sus kyang byas pa med pas rang byung ba 'di tsam na byung ba'i dus med pa/ rin po che sna mi 'dra (469)ba stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa lnga las grub pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa lngas phyag mjad cing de nyid kyi bstan pa 'phel bar mjad pa/

rgyab rol tu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dngos rang byung gi yi ge chen po gsang ba spyod pa sa bon gyi rgyud rgyu dang dus med pa rin po che brgyad rtsa gcig gi rgyu las rang byung ba/ bskal pa re re la sprul pa'i sku brgya phrag gcig gis phyag (470)mjad cing de nyid kyis bstan pa 'phel bar byed pa/ g.yon rol du sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa sku dngos dus med pas byung sa mi shes pa sus kyang ma byas pa rkyen gyis mi shigs pa rin po che sna mi 'dra ba dgu brgya dgu bcu rtsa lnga'i rgyu las rang byung ba skabs su sku las 'od dang zhal nas hūm̐ dang*/ spyan nas ye shes kyi me 'bar zhing 'phro ba sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bskal pa re re la 'phel bar mjad pa'o/ gtso (471)bo'i mdun nas g.yas skor du gdangs chen lnga'i drwa ba'i klong du dga' ldan brtsegs pa'i thig le la sngon gyi gnas dang drang gi ston pa'i smon lam las me tog pad+ma'i steng du ston pa khye'u snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa byis pa lo brgyad pa'i na tshod can rab tu mjes pa kha dog dkar po chu shel ltar dwangs pa la rang bzhin 'od du 'tsher ba 'khor lo'i phyag rgya can 'khor de bzhin gshegs pa (472)stong rtsa gcig gis bskor ba/ gnas sprul sku'i zhing mi mjed 'jig rten gyi thig le la ston pa khye'u 'od mi 'khrugs pa sku dbang po rang gsal ba snang ba'i yan lag yongs su rdzogs pas 'od lnga'i kha dog can rin po che'i phyag rgya can mkha' 'gro ma yid bzungs rdo rje ma la sogs pa mkha' 'gro ma 'bum phrag gnyis kyi 'khor gyis yongs su bskor ba/ sa'i rlan dang rlung gi drod gsher 'dus pa 'od (473)kyi phung po'i thig le la ston pa 'jam dpal 'jigs pa skyobs pa pad+ma gzhon nu rab tu rgyas pa'i kha dog can pad+ma'i phyag rgya mjad pa 'khor rang bzhin gyi byangu ba sems dpa' sogs 'bum phrag drug gis mjes pa chags 'byung mngal du snang ba'i thig le la ston pa gzhon nu rol pa rnam par brtse ba rin po che in+d+ra nī la'i kha dog can ral gri'i phyag rgya mjad pa 'khor (474)gnod sbyin dang brag srin stong phrag lngas bskor ba/

'gro ba nye bar 'tsho ba smon shing gi nags tshal rab tu rgyas pa me tog dang 'bras bu gzhon nus brgyan pa'i thig le la ston pa drug pa rdo rje 'chang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i cha byad can nyid las mi gzhan pa'i 'khor 'od srung sogs sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyis mjes pa/ ri rab kyi byang shar de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba 'jin pa lag na rdo rje (475)gsang ba chen po rol ba'i gnas dur khrod me ri 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i thig le la ston pa gzhon nu dpa' bo stobs dang ldan pa chen po mi'u thung byis pa'i lus dang 'dra ba zhal gsum nas sde snod gsum gyi chos kyi rang sgra sgrogs pa/ phyag drug gi mthil na 'gro ba drug gi grong khyer gsal bar 'jin pa/ zhabs bzhis bdud bzhi rol pas mnan pa 'khor mkha' 'gro ma 'bum phrag grangs med (476)pa dang byang chub sems dpa' sprin gyi shugs can bdun gyis mjes par bskor ba'o/ 'di yan chad lha yul lo/ byang chub shing gis brgyan pa'i byang chub kyi phyogs su gnas srin po ru lu'i sgra dang ldan pa'i thig ler ston pa drang srong khros pa'i rgyal po spyan gsum skal ldan la gzigs pa/ phyag gnyis 'dab bzang gi dbu 'jin pa/ zhabs gnyis tshogs bdag gi gdan la rol pas bzhugs pa 'khor srin po'i (477)rig 'jin bye ba gcig gis bskor ba'o/ gnas bya rgod spung pa'i ri zlum zhing tha gru yangs pa mnyam pa'i thig le la ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom gser 'od dam pa gser gyi gtan pa rdul dang bral ba lta bu gos ngur smrig gi stod g.yog dang smad g.yog gsol ba tshangs par spyod pa'i cha byad can/ 'khor 'phags pa nyan thos rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ gnas byang (478)gi phyogs sog po g.yu yi smin ma can byang chub shing rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bu brtsegs pa'i thig le la ston pa brtse bas rol pa'i blo gros mchog gi sprul sku'i cha byad can/

'khor sa brgyad pa'i byang chub sems dpa' glog gi 'od zer 'byung ba sogs byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi 'khor gyis mjes par bskor ba/ gnas lho phyogs bde ldan yid 'gyur 'dres pa'i tshal bya rgod spung pa'i thig le la (479)ston pa 'od srung bgres po tshangs spyod cha lugs can/ 'khor tshe dang ldan pa 'phags pa zhi zhing dul ba nyon mongs pa'i dgra thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba du ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ gnas byang chub 'byung ba phyogs kun nas rin po che ljon shing mjes pas brgyan pa'i thig le la ston pa yab mngon rdzogs rgyal po longs spyod rdzogs pa'i cha lugs dang ldan pa/ 'khor sku dang gsung dang (480)thugs kyi rigs kyi sems dpas bskor ba/ gnas rgya gar gyi yul ser skya'i grong khyer mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba'i thig le la ston pa bstan pa'i gtso bo shākya thub pa mchog gi sprul sku'i cha byad can/ 'khor rnam pa bzhi'i tshogs kyis kun nas bskor ba'o/ de ltar de dag thams cad ston pa rdo rje 'chang gi sku'i 'od la zhugs shing*/ gsung gi zer la rol pa/ thugs kyi dgongs pa la bzhugs (481)pa rang byung ye shes 'byed pa med pa rang g.yos pa las/ sprul pa mi 'gyur ba dang*/ mi 'gro ba mi 'ong ba mi gnas pa dang*/ mi snang ba mi mjad pa mi 'phro ba mi 'du ba dang*/ lhang nge ba lhan ne ba lhag ge ba thal le ba ste sku'i phyi nang gsang ba'i mjad pa yongs su rdzogs pa/ brjod du med pa bstan du med pa bltar med pa cung zad med pa dang*/ rang bzhin du med pa gyin 'dar med pa yul can yin pa dang*/ (482)du ma med pa dang so ma gnyug ma rnal ma ma bcos pa ste gsung gi phyi nang gsang ba'i mjad pa yongs su rdzogs pa/ dri ma med pa'i ting nge 'jin dang*/ seṅge rnam par bsgyings ba'i ting nge 'jin dang*/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'jin dang*/ yid bzhin nor bu tog gi ting nge 'jin dang*/

rgyal mtshan rtse mo rnam par rol pa'i ting nge 'jin dang*/ glog gi phreng ba dang*/ 'khor lo chen po'i ting nge 'jin dang*/ 'od chen 'bar ba'i ting (483)nge 'jin dang*/ phyag rgya zil gyis gnon pa'i ting nge 'jin dang*/ 'bar chen snyoms pa'i ting nge 'jin dang*/ chos nyid sna tshogs pa'i ting nge 'jin dang*/ rnam par bkod pa rang snang rol pa'i ting nge 'jin la snyom par 'jug pa sku gsum gyi mjad pa ma lus pa yongs su rdzogs pa gsal bar gyur/ dus gsum du gshegs shing 'byon par 'gyur ba byang chub 'byung ba snying po'i zhig gi (484)byang shar dur khrod chen po bsil ba tshal gyi thig ler sa yi lte ba rab tu mtho ba khod snyom zhing lag mthil lta bu la/ mtha' dang dbus dang mtho dman mnyam pa dbus su dpal lha las babs pa'i mchod rten rin po che zangs las grub pa gser gyi char kheb gdugs dang bcas pa/ dril bu dang g.yer kha'i sgra sna tshogs 'byung ba phyogs bzhi na mchod rten re res brgyan pa/ de'i byang shar gyi mtshams ni 'jig (485)rten pa'i lha rten dpag bsam gyi shing bhi sa la la dur bya'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'bab cing gnas pa/ 'jig rten gyi lha dga' byed dbang phyug seng ge nag po la zhon pa/ phyag gnyis na mdung rtsa gsum thogs pa/ dar dmar po'i 'jol ber gyon nas 'gro ba'i tshe srog len pa la thogs pa med pa 'khor bye ba dang bcas pa/ de na gnas pa'i mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu med pa la la (486)mig nas nyi ma'i 'od zer 'byung ba/ la la kha nas 'brug sgra sgrog cing ma he la zhon pa/ la la lag na ral gri thogs shing mig 'bru tshugs su lta ba/ la la lag na thod pa brtsegs pak+ṣathogs shing stag la zhon pa/ la la lag na mi ro thogs pa seng ge la zhon pa/ la la rgyu ma za zhing khyung la zhon pa/ la la rtse gsum mi ro bkal zhing lce spyang zhon pa/ la la khrag mtsho rlabs shing gdong (487)bcu'am lnga la sogs pa yod pa/

la la ni lag pa dpag tu med pa na sems can gyi rnam pa mang po thogs pa dang*/ de bzhin du rang rang gi mgo bo bcad nas lag tu thogs pa/ rang gi snying bton nas lag tu bzung ba dang*/ la la ni rang gi khog pa kha phye nas rgyu ma bzung zhing za ba/ la la rta dang glang po che dang ba glang la zhon pa dpag tu med pa gnas pa'i dbus na (488)mtsho yod pa'id bus su byang chub mchod rten gyi drung du/ rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi'i bdag po slob dpon chen po dga' rab rdo rje dkar gsal dwangs pa chu shel gyi phung po la nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi byin 'khyud pa lta bu g.yas shel gyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa thugs kar gsor zhing g.yon gser gyi phyag shing bsnams pa/ khyab 'jug gi bu mo skra grol zhing gcer bur phyung bas brgyan pa'i khri la rol ba'o/ yang dag (489)par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i nub phyogs dur khrod chen po so sa gling gi thig le las rang byung gi mchod rten rgya che la srid du ring ba 'khor lo gdugs bya rur bcas pa dngul las byas pa/ dril bu dang g.yel kha'i drwa bas rab tu mjes par spras pa/ nyi ma dang zla bas brgyan pa de'i logs la kai ri ma mo brgyad kyi gzugs rang byung du shar ba/ de'i byang shar na spu gri mun zhes bya ba'i (490)mtsho yod pa'i nang du chu srin la sogs pa'i gdug pa can mang pos gang ba/ tha ma rin po chace sna tshogs 'dus pa'i brag gis bskor ba/ ljon shing nag po n+ya kro ta chen po rtse la ngur bya'i tshang yod pa/ sked par na dug sbrul nag po'i tshang yod pa/ rtsa ba na dur phag nag po'i tshang yod pa/ 'jag rten gyi lha ni kun dga' gzhon nu gdong seṅge la lag pa bzhi na ral gri dang*/ mi mgo dang*/ mdung (491)shing dang mdung rtse gsum pa la mi ro bkal nas 'jin pa/ thod pa'i phreng bas lus kun tu brgyan pa dar nag po'i 'jol ber gyon pa/

'khor gsod byed kyi ma mo 'bum gyis bskor nas glang po che la zhon pa rab tu sha dang khrag la dad pa/ mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pa la la ni seṅge la zhon cing skra grol ba/ thod pa dgu brtsegs kyi rgyal mtshan phyar ba/ la la ni bya yi (492)tshogs la zhon nas seṅge'i rgyal mtshan phyar ba/ la la lus bcu gcig la gdong bcu gcig yod pa rgyu ma dang snying la sogs pa za ba dang*/ la la ni bud med nag mo ral pa bsigs shing kha nas spyang kyi 'byung ba/ la la ni mi yi lus la gshogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i gseb nas gnam lcags kyi thog char 'beb pa lag na stag gi rgya mtshan thogs pa/ la la ni lus stod (493)smad 'bral zhing glo snying 'don pa/ la la ni rang gi yan lag bcad nas phyogs pyogs su 'thor ba/ de na ngur gyi bya dang*/ phag dang*/ dug sbrul dngak+ṣa/ ci spyang mdog mi 'dra ba mang po dang*/ spyang ki dang*/ ki li ka dang*/ rab tu 'jigs pa'i bung ba dang*/ ro gsar rnying gi tshogs dpag tu med pa mang po dang*/ rus pa dang khrag gi rgya mtsho dang*/ mi mgo'i khang pa dang*/ thod pa (494)skam po'i khang pa rnam pa brtsegs pa/ la la 'brad/ la la za/ la la rgyug la la ngu*/ la la mig 'byin pa/ la la rkang 'cha' zhing rus pa mur ba rgyu ma sogs za zhing rnal 'byor gyi dbang pyug brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mjad pa sna tshogs kyis gang ba de'i dbus su mkhyen rab kyi bdag po slob dpon chen po 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gurgum gyi me tog gsar ba'i mdog can seṅge bsnol ba'i khri steng na (495)rdo rje'i skyil krung du bzhugs te/ gser dang*/ dngul dang*/ rma bya la sogs pa'i gdugs phub pa'i rgyal mtshan sna tshogs bslang zhing*/ dur khrod khang bu brtsegs pa na bzhugs shing mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor nas ting nge 'jin la snyom par zhugs pa/ shar phyogs kyi dur khrod chen po bsil byed kyi thig le ljon shing dang bza' shing gi ra bas yongs su bskor ba de'i nang (496)rim na shing ka ra wi ri'i phreng bas bskor ba/

de'i nang na smyug ma dang 'dam bu'i tshal yod pa/ de'i dbus na ro gsar snying gi tshogs dpag tu med pa yod pa na mkha' 'gro ma dngos su sgra mang po 'don pa/ sha za zhing khrag 'thung ba rus pa'i tshogs mang po 'cha' zhing lding ba/ gzugs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs dang*/ kha dog mi 'dra ba rnam pa sna tshogs dang*/ de bzhin du dung 'bud pa la sogs pa'i sgra rnam pa sna tshogs pa 'byin pa'i dbus na (497)thod pa'i khang bu brtsegs pa rtse la me 'bar zhing du ba sna tshogs 'thul ba/ sked pa na zhags 'jin zhing rtsa ba na klu'i bu mo dag khrus byed cing yod pa de'i dbus na rig 'jin chen po shrī seng ha mchong smug dwangs pa'i mdog can glang po che bsnol ba'i khri steng na khyab 'jug gcer bur phyung ba'i steng na rdo rje'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ skabs su khyad par spyod pa stag dang ma he la (498)zhon cing sku lus gcer bu la khrag dang zhag gis byug pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs la sgro na tshogs pa btsugs te phyag g.yas pa na ral gri phyar zhing g.yon pa na thod pa khrag gis bkang ba zhal du gsol zhing dur khrod rnams su rgyu ba dang*/ res glang po che la zhon nas lus la stag gi lpags pa gyon pa/ phyag na ḍa ma ru dkrol zhing srid pa spyi blugs kyi zhwa gyon pa dur khrod du rgyu ba la sogs pa'i spyod (499)pa sna tshogs mjad pa/ res sa chu me rlung gi rten 'brel du mjad pa/ lha dang lha min la sogs pas gdug pa dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dang*/ dar gyi lha ldi la sogs pa phyar zhing rab tu 'dud pa/ rgya gar bha sing nags kyi dur khrod kyi thig le de'i byang na ri nag po glang po che nyal ba lta bu'i kha nas chu 'bab pa/ lho na stag ser bo langs pa lta bu'i ri las tsan+da gor shi ṣa'i (500)dri 'thul ba/ nub na seṅge gnam la mchong pa'i ri la bya khyung gi tshang yod pa/ shar na tshangs pa lha'i zhal lta bu'i shing las dgos 'dod gang yang 'byung ba'i dbus su bsod nams rdzogs pa'i mchod rten rgyu rin po che zangs lcags las byas pa srog shing tsan+da sbrul gyi snying po can rde mo shing 'dab pad+ma bkram pa lta bu'i gdugs dang*/

sked par rin po che mthon mthing gi 'khor lo brtsegs pa/ rtsa bar (501)pad+ma'i snying po kha sbyar ba lta bu'i bang rim gyi ngos la yod dpa/ bang rim tha ma'i steng na shing gi rgyal po seng dha phyogs kun na yod pa'i yal ga dang lo ma 'i tshogs thams cad gcig la gcig 'brel ba g.yu'i ba thag brgyang ba lta bu'i drwa ba dang*/ drwa ba phyed pa bang rim 'og ma rnams na dur khrod na gnas pa'i srog chags du ma yod pa/ de'i steng na lha'i bu mo mang po dang*/ de'i steng na (502)bsil byed thogs pa'i dge bsnyen ma mang pos bskor ba byed pa/ steng du bya rigs mang pos gang ba/ de'i lho na 'jig rten pa'i lha rten shel gyi khang pa sgo yod pa'i nang na gshin rje dus mtshan mdog nag la skra g.yeng zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ gsus pa che la mig gyen la ldog pa 'jig rten pa'i ma mo stong gis bskor ba/ de'i steng du 'jam bu'i gling bskyod par byed pa'i lha tsun+dha ri mdog dmar po gcer bu bong (503)bu la zhon pa/ khrag gi ral pa g.yeng zhing sa gzhi khengs pa/ mig nas du ba 'thul ba/ kha nas me 'bar ba lag pa g.yas pa na mdung rtse gsum la mi ro brgyang thabs su bkal ba/ g.yon na bum pa 'jin pa/ bdud kyi 'khor brgyad brgyas bskor ba/ las su gson khrag 'jib ba/ dam tshig nyams pa'i gshed ma mjad pa/ dur khrod de na ro gsar snying gi tshogs dpag tu med (504)pa gcig gi steng na gcig chags pa/ de'i phyogs mtshams na mi mgo rlon pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i shar na mkhas pa dpal gyi blo gros khyung la zhon cing khams gsum kun tu 'gro bar byed pa/ mdog smug nag la gdong lnga sa ral pa'i thor tshugs gyen du 'khyil ba'i gseb na thod pa'i phreng bas bskor ba/ phyag bcu na 'khor lo dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ mdung shing*/ zhing chung dang*/ mda' gzhu thogs pa/ g.yon na dge slong (505)dang*/ seṅge dang*/ spyang khyi dang*/ ba dan dang*/

gzhu la sogs pa thogs pa/ lus la dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa 'khor zhi ba'i rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma stong gis bskor ba/ lho na mkha' 'gro ma mgon sems ma mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa tshogs bdag la zhon pa/ gcer bu 'jigs pa'i gzugs can g.yu dang mu men gyi gshogs pa gdeng*/ (506)g.yas na thod pa'i nang na phag mo'i chang gis bkang ba/ g.yon dngos grub gyi gzugs 'jin pa/ mig 'bru tshugs su blta zhing zhal bgrad pa/ rgyas pa'i mkha' 'gro ma stong dang bcas pa/ nub na 'bar ma chen mo mdog dmar mo skra brdzes pa gcer bu g.yas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon zhags pa rkyong ba ri dwags la zhon pa dbang gi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma stong dang bcas pa/ byang na kun tu bzang mo mdog ljang ku gcer (507)bu skra grol ba/ g.yas 'ug pa g.yon na bya khra thogs pa/ spyang ki la zhon pa las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma stong dang bcas pa/ byang shar na me khyer glog gi phreng ba 'jin pa mdog ljang gu gcer bu skra brdzes pa g.yas ral gri'i phreng ba dang*/ g.yon bsdigs mjub mjad pa ma he la zhon pa 'khor gsod byed kyi ma mo bdun gyis bskor ba/ shar lho na sha ba ri sngo bsang (508)gcer bu skra grol ba phyag gnyis na bam chen bzung ste za ba glang chen la zhon pa/ sgrol bar byed pa'i ging mo bdun gyis bskor ba/ lho nub na brag skyes mo sngo skya gcer bu skra'i mdud pa rgyab tu bcings pa/ lag na seṅge'i rgyal mtshan 'jin pa/ kha nas hūm̐ zhes sgrogs pa ro la zhon pa zla ba'i 'od 'phro ba/ sha za ma mo bdun gyis bskor ba/ nub byang na chags med ma mdog smug nag skra gcig (509)g.yas nas g.yon du 'khyil ba/ mig gcig gis stong gsum dus gcig la mthong ba/ so gcig gis dam nyams kyi srog rtsa gcod pa/ lag pa gcig gis nad kyi rgyal ba dus gcig la 'jin pa/ nu ma gcig gis 'gro ba rnams dus gcig la gso ba/

rkang pa gcig gis 'khor 'das dus gcig la 'khor ba/ nad dang khrag la dga' ba 'chi bdag gi ma mo (510)bdun gyis bskor ba/ byol song gi rigs dang*/ sprul pa'i ma mo dpag tu med pa/ de dag gi lho na lte ba rin po che la slob dpon chen po ye shes mdo pad+ma dkar po rab tu rgyas pa'i kha dog can rin po che'i khri rkang brtsegs pa stag mo grus mas btegs pa'i steng na skyil mo krung gis bzhugs nas phyag mchog sbyin mjad pa/ rma bya'i gdugs phub nas phyogs kun nas ba dan dang*/ bsil yab la sogs bslang ba'i (511)dbus su mkha' 'gro ma rnams la chos ston pa/ nub phyogs su dur khrod chen po rab tu snang byed kyi thig le nags tshal 'thugs po rab tu rgyas pa'i dkyil du ne'u seng ge thang chen po'i dbus na rnam par rgyal ba 'khor ba 'jigs zhes bya ba'i mchod rten khri lcags las byas pa/ bang rim rnams zangs dang mu men dang gser las byas pa/ pad+ma rin po che ze smyug las byas pa bum pa rin po che mthon mthing dang*/ bre rin po che phra men dang*/ 'khor lo (512)rnams rin po che'i rigs mi 'dra ba bcu gsum las byas pa/ gdugs rin po che sna tshogs 'dus shing 'khrigs pa las gyur pa/ nyi zla dang bya ru la sogs pa rang bzhin gyi rnam dag chenapo las byung ba/ de'i mtha' na chu'i 'obs yod pa/ de'i nang du klu'i phru gu rnams dag byed kyi khrus byed pa/ de'i lho nub na 'jig rten pa'i lha rten smyug ma'i phung po 'dra ba'i rnam pa dang drwa bas yongs su bskor ba'i nang nas mtshe'u (513)g.yu'i maṇ+ḍal 'dra ba'i steng na/ gser gyi bye ma brdal ba lta bu'i kha dog ser po'i sprin gyi klong na mthing shun gyi gur phub 'i nang na/ klu'i rgyal po sa srung mdog ser po stod sbrul mgo bdun pa gdeng ba'i dbus na nor bu rin po che yod pa/ lag pa gnyis na bum pa dang sbrul zhags thogs pa/

chu srin sngon po la zhon pa/ 'khor klu'i rigs brgyad kyis bskor ba/ dur khrod de na mkha' (514)'gro ma la la ni dmar mo khrag gi ral pa bshig cing rwa dung 'bud pa/ la la ni ling du la zhon nas sngon po g.yu yi go cog gyon pa/ lag na ro thogs pa/ de bzhin du stag la zhon cing dkar po khyung gi gshogs pa gsal ba lag na rin po che'i bum pa nor gyis bkang ba thogs pa/ srin mo ral pa bsigs pa gcer bu skyes pa la zhon pa mdog dmar skya dung gi gdugs 'jin cing kha nas khus 'debs pa/ gzhan (515)yang sha za dang khrag 'thung rus pa 'cha' ba glo snying nang khrol za ba la sogs pa dpag tu med pa stag dang seṅge la sogs pa'i gcan gzan dang*/ kang ka dang ling du la sogs pa 'dab chags mang po dpag tu med pas gang ba de'i dbus na 'chi ba med pa 'pho ba chen po'i go 'phang brnyes pa dri med bshes gnyen dung la pho tshos bskus pa'i mdog can stag la zhon nas mdung rtse gsum pa bsnams nas spyod (516)pa mjad pa/ res ma he la zhon nas mi ro'i rgyal mtshan phyar ba/ res glang chen la zhon nas ba dan dmar po phyar ba/ res ci spyang la zhon nas phyag gnyis na ral gri 'jin pa/ res ling du dang 'ug pa'i tshogs la zhon nas phyag gnyis na gdugs gnyis bsnams nas mkha' 'gro ma dbang du sdud pa'i dgongs pa la snyom par zhugs pa/ de ltar rig 'jin rnams khyad par gyi spyod pa skyong ba'i dus su sku mdog (517)dang phyag mtshan cir yang 'char bas mkha' 'gro ma dbang du sdud pas cir yang 'char ba gsal bar gyur/ pad+ma'i nang khong gi 'khor yug la nyang ting 'jin bzang po/ gnas brtan ldang ma lhun gyi rgyal mtshan/ lce btsun chen po seng he shwa ra/ sprul sku rgyal ba zhang ston/ gu ru mkhas pa nyi 'bum/ chos bdag gu ru jo 'bel/ 'khrul zhig seng ge rgyab pa/ grub chen zla (518)ba mun sel/ rig 'jin gyi sa la gshegs pa chos rje ku ma rā ja/
kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa/ 'jigs med rgyal ba'i myu gu/ o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po/ lung rtogs bstan pa'i nyi ma/ 'od gsal rin chen snying po pad+ma las 'brel rtsal/

skyabs rjes gco bor byed byed tshe 'dir 'jud mchan/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams brtul zhugs spyod pa'i cha byad can no/ gtso bo'i g.yas rol gyi nam mkha' la seng khri pad zla'i gdan la bstan pa'i bdag po de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thug pa mngon sum (519)bzhin du bzhugs pa'i g.yas su 'jam dpal dbyangs zhi ba lha/ e la dha ri/ ma hā shrī rat+na/ bha wa badz+ra/ dharmā kirti/ dī paṃ ka ra/ su ma ti/ lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab/ tshe spong ba chos kyi bla ma phywa pa chos kyi seng ge dan 'bag pa dar ma bkra shis/ shes rab blo gros shes rab dbang phyug sangs rgyas brtson 'grus/ dben dge ba shākya seng ge (520)bla brang ba chos dpal rgyal mtshan sogs zab mo lta ba brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ g.yon phyogs su byams pa/ thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ 'phags pa rnam grol sde/ btsun pa grol sde/ mchog gi sde/ dul ba'i sde/ rnam par snang mjad bzang po/ seng ge bzang po/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ gu ṇa mi tra/ ran+ta par pa tha/ 'bum phrag gsum pa/ blo ldan (521)shes rab/ 'bre shes rab 'bar/ ar byang chub ye shes/ khu shes rab brtson 'grus/ dkar chung ring mo ba/ zhang g.yel ba/ dmyal ba zhig po/ rgya phying ru pa/ chu mig pa seṅge dpal/ blo grags pa/ bla ma btsan dgon pa sogs rgya chen spyod pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ mdun du 'phags pa klu sgrub/ zla ba grags pa/ rig pa'i khu byug ku su lu ba che chung*/ (522)jo bo rje/ bal po thang*/ pa ja/ a bha a ka ra/ byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan/ gro lung ba chen po spyi bo lhas pa byang chub 'od/ rma shākya seng ge mchims nam mkha' grags/ mkhan po smon lam tshul khrims/ slob dpon byang chub grub/ slob dpon gzhon nu rdo rje sogs chos nyid don gyi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams bzhugs pa/ g.yon phyogs kyi steng gi nam mkhar seng khri pad zla'i gdan la rgyal sras (523)rigs gsum mgon po/

rgyal po ja/ in+d+ra bhu ti/ sras shākya bhu ti/ ku ku rā ja/ pad+ma sam+bha wa/ gnyags dzñā na ku ma/ rma rin chen mchog kye re mchog skyong*/ dar rje dpal gyi grags pa/ gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes/ spa gor blo chen 'phags/ dan yon tan mchog bogs gsal ba'i byang chub/ rgya blo gros gzhon nu/ mgar tshul khrims bzang po (524)mtshur ye shes dbang po/ dan chos kyi dbang phyug zhang mchog gi bla ma gyi yon tan 'byung gnas/ slob dpon gzhon nu don 'grub sogs 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par gyur/ gsum pa/ de ltar gsal ba'i lha tshogs rnams kyi gnas gsum rdo rje gsum gyis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros rtsa ba'i bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa so so'i gnas nas spyan drangs par gyur/ (525)oṃ/ ye shes sku mchog rang bzhin dkyil 'khor ni/ zla rgyas bzhin du spros pa mi mnga' yang*/ thugs rje nyi bzhin 'od gas snyom mjad de/ 'dir gshegs bdag la la dgongs shing bzhugs su gsol/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs ldan pa/ zag pa rang zad dbyings nas sku gshegs pa'i/ dri ma rang dag dbyings nas spyan gyis gzigs/ thugs rje (526)rang shugs chen pos don mjad pa'i/ bde gshegs 'jig rten mkhyen pa'i thugs mnga' bas/ dgongs pa nyag gcig mi g.yo dbyer med kyang*/ sngon bzhugs dur khrod gnas nas rjes dgongs la/ rang bzhin mjad pa gang yang mi mnga' yang*/ bdag blo mos pa'i don phyir 'dir gshegs shig e h+ya hi bha ga wan ma hā ka ru ṇi ka dṛ sha ya ho sa ma ya jaḥhūm̐ bam hoḥ zhes brjod pas phyogs bcu'i zhing khams nas dkon (527)mchog gsum po byon te nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad gang bar bsam mo/ de ltar byon pa'i lam du khrus khang lha yi bu dang bu mo mang pos brgyan par rin po che'i bum pas sku khrus gsol ba'i rjes su khrus ras kyis phyis te na bza' gsol bar bsam la/

khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa/ shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba bstar/ rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan/ mu tig 'od chags bla bre bres pa der/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang de yi sras rnams la/ rin chen (528)bum pa mang po spos kyi chus/ yid 'ong legs par bkang ba'i glu dang ni/ rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o/ de nas de la kha dog logs bsgyur ba'i/ na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul/ gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*/ rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dag de dag gis/ 'phags pa kun tu (529)bzang dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs la'ang brgyan par bgyi/ stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldan pa yi/ dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang kun gyi sku/ gser sbyang btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar/ 'od chags 'bar ba de la byugs par bgyi/ zhes/ gnas khang du gdan so so la bzhugs par gyur/ bzhi pa mchod pa la yan lag bdun gyis mchod pa'i/ dang po phyag 'tshal ba ni/ yid 'ong rdzing bu'i nang (530)na gnas pa yi/ 'char kha'i pad+ma'i kha 'bus phye 'dra ba/ lag gnyis spyi bor thal sbyar bstod dbyangs bcas/ lus dpag med par sprul nas gus phyag 'tshal/ gnyis pa mchod pa'i yan lag la/ mdor bstan pa ni/ dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul te/ mchod pa bla med rgya chen rnams kyis mchod/ rgyas par dngos bshams kyis mchod pa ni/ me tog spos dang mar me zhal zas dang*/ bla bre 'phan ldi nga gdugs dang rol mo'i (531)sgra/ rgyal mtshan rnga yab rdza rnga la sogs dang*/ lus dang longs spyod mkho dgu'i yo byad kyis/ 'gro ba'i bla ma dkon mchog sras bcas mchod/ 'di dag kyang bkod pa tshad med par bkod de 'bul ba ni/ thub dbang mchod gnas mchog la yid 'ong ba'i/ me tog man+da ra dang pad+ma dang*/ ut+pal la sogs dri zhim thams cad dang*/

phreng ba spel legs yid 'ong rnams kyis mchod/ spos (532)mchog yid 'ong dri ngad khyab pa yi/ bdug pa'i sprin tshogs rnams kyang de la 'bul/ zhal zas bza' btung sna tshogs bcas pa yi/ lha bshos rnams kyang de la 'bul bar bgyi/ gser gyi pad+ma tshar du ngar ba yi/ rin chen sgron me rnams kyang dbul bar bgyi/ rin chen gdugs mjes gser gyi yu ba can/ khor yug rgyan gyi rnam pa yid 'ong ldan/ dbyibs legs blta na sdug pa bsgreng ba (533)yang*/ rtag tu thub dbang rnams la 'bul bar bgyi/ zhes dang*/ gnyis pa yid kyis sprul pa la lnga las lha rdzas kyi mchod pa yid las byung ba sum cu rtsa gsum la sogs pa'i/ lha sogs 'jig rten na yang yid 'ong ba'i/ gzhal med khang brtsegs rin chen drwa ba can/ glu gar sil snyan bstod dbyangs char 'beb cing*/ rgyan mchog brgya phrag mnga' ba rnams kyis mchod/ de yang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad lha'i gzhal yas khang bstod dbyangs len (534) cing me tog gi char 'bebs pas gang bar bsam ste mchod pa ni/ gzhal med pho brang bstod dbyangs yid 'ong ldan/ mu tig rin chen rgyan 'phyang mjes 'bar ba/ dpag yas nam mkha'i rgyan gyur de dag kun/ thugs rjes rang bzhin can la 'bul bar bgyi/ bdag pos ma bzung ba'i mchod pa lnga ni/ gzhan yang 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par dag pa na/ rin chen ri bo nags tshal pad+ma'i mtsho/ ngang mo'i 'gros kyis gnyer ba de dag dang*/ sman (535)sogs dri zhim dang ldang dpag bsam shing*/ me tog 'bras bu dud pa'i tshogs kyis mchod/ zhes mdor bstan nas/ me tog 'bras bu ji snyed yod pa dang*/ sman gyi rnam pa gang dag yod pa dang*/ 'jig rten rin chen ji snyed yod pa dang*/ chu gtsang yid du 'ong ba ji yod dang*/ rin chen ri bo dang ni de bzhin du/ nags tshal sa phyogs dben zhing nyams dga' dang*/ ljon shing me tog rgyan (536)spras spud pa dang*/

shing gang 'bras bzang yal ga dud pas mchod/ gzhan yang*/ 'dab stong g.yo bas bung ba bzung ba yi/ lag pa'i gdu bu ku mu das mtshan zhing*/ sprin bral nyi zla'i zer gyis rab phye ba'i/ ut+pal la sogs yid 'ong rnams kyis mchod/ gzhan yang*/ tsan+da bsil ba'i kha yi sbubs bskyod pa'i/ dri zhim ser bu bde ba'i ngang rnams dang*/ phug dang brag ri sman ljongs nyams dga' ba (537)chu bsil rdzing bu gang ba rnams kyis mchod/ mtsho dang rdzing bu pad+mas brgyan pa dag ngang pa skad snyan shin tu yid 'ong ldan/ ma rmos 'khrungs pa'i lo thog rnam pa dang*/ gzhan yang mchod par 'os pa'i rgyan gyis mchod/ ston ka'i mtshan mo dkar ba'i ri bong 'jin/ gza' bral rgyu skar phreng bas bskor ba dang*/ nyin byed 'od stong drwa bas mjes 'bar ba/ gling bzhi'i 'jig rten (538)rgyan gyur rnams kyis mchod/ gzhan yang*/ 'khor yug rigs bcas bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing*/ ma lus yongs bkod 'dod rgu'i 'byor pa dang*/ phyogs bcu+i zhing khams rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed kun/ blo yis blangs te thub dbang sras bcas mchod/ bdag pos bzung ba'i mchod pa ni gzhan yang 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i/ bum bzang dpag bsam shing dang 'dod 'jo'i ba/ rgyal srid bdun dang bkra shis rdzas brgyad dang*/ nye ba'i (539)rin chen bdun sogs rgya che ba/ yon gnas dam pa thugs rje can rnams mchod/ ting nge 'jin rgya mtsho'i mchod pa gnyis ni/ kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi bkod pa las ches lhag pa tsam du bsam te/ ting 'jin yid kyi nam mkha'i dbyings khyab par/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ de yang rnam pa gsum las dang po ni/ me tog sprin mjes lding khang mjes 'bar ba/ spos dang (540)sman sbyar bdud rtsi'i sprin phung dang*/ gzi ldan sgron me zhal zas rol mo'i sprin/ bstod dbyangs yan yag rgya mtsho'i sprin gyis mchod/ thun mong ma yin pa'i mchod pa gnyis ni/

nang dang gsang ba'i mchod pa ni blo yi/ 'jug pa'i sprin can shin tu mtha' yas pa/ sgegs mo phreng thogs rin chen glu gar sogs/ mchod pa'i lha mo sna tshogs sprin 'phro bas/ rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus mnyes gyur cig gces par bzung ba'i lus 'bul ba ni/ (541)nam mkhar rab 'byams khams kyi mthas gtug par/ yongs su bzung ba med pa de dag kun/ blo yi blangs nas thub dbang skyes kyi mchog sras dang bcas pa rnams la legs 'bul na/ yon gnas dam pa thugs rje che rnams kyis/ bdag la brtser dgongs bdag gi 'di dag bzhes/ bdag ni bsod nams mi ldan bkren chen te/ mchod pa'i nor gzhan bdag la cang ma mchis/ (542)des na gzhan don dgongs pa'i mgon gyis 'dir/ bdag gi don slad nyid kyi mthus bzhes shig rgyal dang de sras rnams la bdag gi ni/ bdag gi lus kun gtan du dbul ba bgyi/ sems dpa' mchog rnams bdag ni yongs bzhes shig sdig pa bshags pa ni/ thog med dus nas goms pa'i bag chags kyis/ las dang nyon mongs sdig pa ci bgyis pa/ srid pa'i rgyur gyur de kun bshags par bgyi/ de yang (543) stobs bzhi'i bshags pa ni/ phyogs rnams kun na bzhugs pa yi/ rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems/ thugs rje chen po mnga' rnams la/ thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni/ thog ma med ldan 'khor ba nas/ tshe rabs 'di'am gzhan dag tu/ bdag gis ma 'tshal sdig bgyis pa'am/ bgyi du stsal ba nyid dang ni/ gti mgu 'khrul bas bdag non te/ rjes su yi rang gang bgyis (544)pa/ nongs pa de ni mthong bgyis nas/ bsam pa dag pas mgon la bshags/ bdag gis dkon mchog gsum dang ni/ pha ma'am bla ma gzhan dag la/ nyon mongs sgo nas lus dang ngag yid kyis gnod bgyis gang lags dang*/ nyes pa du mas skyon chags pa'i/ sdig can bdag gi sdig pa gang*/ shin tu mi bzad bgyis pa ste/ thams cad 'dren pa rnams la 'chags/ yan lag phyi ma rnams ni/

(545)'gro ba'i bsod nams phung po mtha' yas la/ rtag tu bdag ni rjes su yi rang ngo*/ ma lus skye dgu'i tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ chos kyi 'khor lo bla med bskor bar bskul/ deng nas srid pa'i rgya mtsho ma stong bar/ mya ngan mi 'da' rtag tu bzhugs par gsol/ dge ba de yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ ma lus phyam gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par shog lnga pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi yon tan (546) bsam pa'i sgo nas bstod pa ni/ e ma mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i skad/ sna tshogs chos rnams thams cad don gcig par/ ston par byed pa bla ma nyid yin te/ 'jig rten 'dren phyir kun dang cha mthun la/ 'jig rten 'das phyir kun dang cha mi mthun/ sgo gsum spyod pa kun las khyad par 'phags/ zhi sku kun spyod gtsang zhing skyon med pa/ the tshom gcod pa mkhas gsung snyan dri ma med/ (547)thugs ni zab zhi kun mkhyen ye shes mjod/ yon tan mtha' yas thos dang snying rje che/ shes rab rgya che dgongs spyod nam mkha' 'dra/ phrin las tshad med 'brel tshad don dang ldan/ byams ldan skyo ngal spangs shing rtag tu brtson/ 'gro ba'i kha lo gyon du bsgyur la bstod/ khyad par gsang sngags bla ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ dbang dang sdom pa dam tshig (548)gtsang ldan zhing*/ rgyud don man ngag rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin/ bsnyen sgrub las sbyor phrin las mnga' brnyes shing*/ lta sgom spyod 'bras nyams rtogs drod tshad thob/ brtse chen thabs mkhas gdul bya smin grol 'god/ brgyud pa'i byin rlabs sprin phung ma yal ba/ de 'dra'i mkhas grub dpal ldan bla mar bstod/ gang gi yon tan shin tu mtha' yas te/ 'gro ba'i gnyen gyur phyogs tsam (549)rab sngags na/ srid mtsho sgrol bas gru chacen mnyan pa ste/ lam zhugs rnams kyi ded dpon bla na med/ rgud pa sel bas yid bzhin nor bu ste/ las dang nyon mongs me 'jil bdud rtsi'i chu/ chos char bsil bar char sprin bzang po ste/

'gro kun dga' bskyed lha yi rnga bo che/ dug gsum nad sel sman pa'i rgyal po ste/ ma rig mun sel sgron me 'od po che/ skye rgu'i (550)bde 'byung dpag bsam shing chen te/ 'dod rgu lhun grub rin chen bum pa bzang*/ byams chen nyi ma 'od zer dpag med de/ gdung sel zla ba phan bde'i 'od dkar can/ dgongs klong yangs pa'i dri med mkha' 'dra la/ ting 'jin 'od gsal gza' skar lhun grub 'dra/ mkhyen brtse rang bzhin dpag med mtsho 'dra zhing*/ thugs rje rlabs chen g.yo bas chu klung 'dra/ rnam g.yeng mi bskyod (551)gangs ri'i dpal 'dra zhing*/ mchog tu mi g.yo ri rgyal lhan po 'dra/ srid gnas mi gos 'dam skyes pad 'dra zhing*/ kun la thugs snyom byams sdug pha ma 'dra/ yon tan mtha' yas rin chen gter 'dra zhing*/ 'jig rten 'dren pa rgyal ba'i dbang po bzhin/ de 'dra'i bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi rje/ gang na bzhugs kyang sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ mthong thos dran reg 'khor ba (552)phyir bsnyil zhing*/ rlabs chen phrin las khur chen dpag tu med/ sa chen 'gro ba kun gyi rten gzhi'o/ dkon mchog bzhi pa bla ma sangs rgyas te/ dkyil 'khor dbang phyug he ru ka dpal nyid/ snyigs dus 'gro ba gdul ka'i don mjad pas/ gdul bya'i ngor ni sangs rgyas kun las lhag dngos grub rtsa ba rdo rje slob dpon la/ sgo gsum zol med gtsang ma'i spyi bos bstod/ de dag gis (553)ni ngan 'gro'i lam 'gog cing*/ bde 'gro'i skas 'jugs 'di phyir phan bde mjad/ yang dag nges don sems rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ tshe 'dir smin grol lam la 'god pas na/ rtag brtan 'pho 'gyur med pa'i dad pa yis/ dus rnams kun tu skyo ngal med pas bstod/

drug pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bla ma rdo rje 'jin pa rnams dgongs su gsol/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang (554)byang chub sems dpa' rnams te rdo rje dang rin po che dang pad+ma dang las dang bde bar gshegs pa'i rigs thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag la 'di zhes bya ba dus 'di nas bzung ste snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du bla ma rdo rje 'jin pa chen pos bdag gi lus byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gi ngag byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gi yid byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gi snang ba (555)byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ smin par mjad du gsol/ grol bar mjad du gsol/ gang bar mjad du gsol/ cher 'phel bar mjad du gsol/ oṃ/ skye 'chi med pa gsal la dngas/ rdo rje'i sku la gsol ba 'debs/ lus la bde ba rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ āḥ 'gags pa med pa chos kyi sgra/ ā li kā lir gsol ba 'debs/ ngag la nus pa 'bar bar (556)byin gyis rlobs/ hūm̐/ ka dag chen po kun bzang klong*/ cir mi dgongs la gsol ba 'debs/ chos nyid zad par 'khyol bar byin gyis rlobs/ bla ma rdo rje 'jin pa ni/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnyen gcig pu/ 'gro ba mgon med rnams kyi skyabs/ thar ba'i lam skas chen po ste/ ma rig sel ba'i sgron me la/ mun pa'i tshogs bdag skyabs su mchi/ 'khor ba (557)'dam gyi tshogs nang du/ bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyob/ nyon mongs me yis gdung ba la/ thugs rje'i char gyis bsil bar mjod/ bdag ni bskal pa thogs med nas/ gdos bcas lus kyis bcings pa la/ rnam smin phung po'i rgyud dag nas/ 'od gsalal dri med lus thob mjod/ brjod pa ngag gis bcings pa la/ smra rgyud zhen pa rang dag nas/ brjod med chos (558)nyid ngag thob mjod/ 'khrul rtog sems kyis bcings pa la/ 'phro 'du'i zhen pa rang dag nas/ mi rtog ye shes thugs thob mjod/ bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che/

bdag la re sa gzhan na med/ 'di nas byang chub ma thob par/ skyid sdug re ltos khyed mkhyen pas/ mgon med bdag la thugs rjes zungs/ nad gdon bgegs dang bar chad sel/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis rlobs/ (559)mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ zhes gsol ba btabs pas/ sku'i cha shas nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs lus kyi nang kheng*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib dag bde chen chos nyid kyi rtogs pa skye bar bsam la dar gcig mnyam par bzhag bdun pa bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rnam par snang mjad kyi thugs kar pad+ma nyi ma'i steng gi kun bzang yab yum gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ ma rtogs pa'i sems can (560)gyi sgrib pa sbyangs nas thams cad lhar gyur/ 'phags pa mchod/ sngags kyi rang sgras 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.a/ ces ci 'grub tu bzlas/ de nas zab lam bye brag tu bsgom pa ni/ rang gi spyi bor bla ma rnams kyi sku'i cha thams cad nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas lus ngag yid gsum la thim par bsam la/ oṃ āḥm hā gu ru sha ri raṃ ghi li hūm̐/ (561) dang rig 'jin spyi dril/ oṃ āḥm hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes bzla'o/ de nas rdzogs rim bsgom pa ni/ sngon 'gro las sel gyi gnad la gsum rtsa sbyang ba stong ra'i gnad ni/ rang gi 'khor lo bzhi'i dbus na ro rkyang kun rdar ma gsum ka ba'i tshul du yod pa'i nang sbug ma stong seng ge ba la dmigs pa bzung bas gtso bor dbu ma'i nang phru ma phus gdab pa lta bu/ dang po mda' smyug tsam/ de nas spos dong tsam/ de nas zho zo tsam/ de nas lus thams cad dbu ma'i nang tsam bsgom/ 'dis ni rlung sems thams cad dbu mar tshud pa'i (562) gnad do/ de nas rlung sbyang ba srog gi gnad ni/ de ltar dbu ma dang 'khor lo bzhi steng par gsal ba'i g.yas g.yon ro rkyang gi yar sna gnyis nas smin mtshams nas sna bug gi nang gnyis la zug cing*/

mar sna gnyis lte ba'i 'og sor bzhi'i cha spu na gru'i thad nas dbu mar gug pa'i tshul du tshur par bsam/ rlung ro dbus nas phyir 'phang dus na dang sdig sgrib thams cad phyir sangs/ nang du 'dren dus snod bcud brtan g.yo'i 'jig rten sangs rgyas dang byang chus sems dpa'i yon tan dang bcas pa rlung gi rnam pas sna bug nas ro rkyang gi nang nas byung ba dbu ma'i nang du tshud (563) pa la dmigs pa bzung nas 'jam rlung dal bus 'jin cing*/ rang babs kyi 'byung rngub las cha babs su 'jin pa ni gnad yang dag pa'o/ de ltar byas pas rlung skyon med par ngang gis zin cing 'byong ngo*/ thig le sbyong ba'i gnad ni/ gtum mo'i rnal 'byor bsgom pas/ lte ba'i thad sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus dbu ma'i nang na/ me'i dwangs ma rgya khab kyi rtse'i yungs dkar gyi yang zhun tsam la/ a shad kyi rnam pa can reg bya shin tu tsha ba gcig bsgom la ro rkyang gi rlung dbu ma'i mar snar zhugs pa'i dwangs ma des sbar bas/ me rta rnga'i nyag tsam 'bar ba dbu ma'i nang bde chen (564) 'khor lo'i thad ka'i dkyil na haṃ mgo thur du blta ba sran ma'i ga'u tsam la reg pas/ thig le dkar dmar gyi thigs pa phra mo mar bab/ lte ba'i me'i gsos byas/ de bas kyang me cher 'bar rim bzhin haṃ las thigs pa cher babs pas dbu ma'i nang kheng*/ dwangs ma 'khor lo bzhi'i rtsa 'dab stong pa rnams gang ba la ma yengasha bar bsgom pas/ lus sems bde ba chen por ngang gis 'char ro/ de nas dngos gzhi khyad par can gyi gnad las brtan dang mas brtan gyi ye shes kun tu bzang po bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes dang gsum las/ dang po la bzhi las/ bde chen 'khor lo'i man ngag ni/ (565) 'khor lo bzhi'i dbus na dbu ma ye shes kyi rtsa la dwangs ma'i dwangs ma dkar dmar 'dres pa nyungs 'bru tsam gyi rten la 'od lnga'i gong bu sran ma rgog po tsam re bsam pa'i spyi gtsug gi dwangs ma nyugs 'bru tsam la mgrin pa'i dwangs ma 'od dang bcas pa'i drod kyis zhu/

byang chub sems kyi thigs pa skra'i nyag ma tsam babs pas spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab dang*/ mgrin pa'i rten gyi dwangs ma la zhugs/ tshad med pa'i bde ba'i khyad par bsam la 'jam rlung rang zhir bzung*/ de nas/ snying ga'i 'od dang dwangs ma'i drod kyis mgrin pa'i rten gyi dwangs (566) ma bzhus/ longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab dang snying ga'i rten la zhugs/ zag pa medapa'i bde ba bskyed par bsam/ de nas lte ba'i 'od dang thig le'i drod kyis snying ga'i rten gyi dwangs ma zhu bas/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab dang lte ba'i rten gyi thig le la zhugs/ mchog tu bde ba'i ye shes bskyed par bsam mo/ de nas snying ga'i 'od rten gyis dwangs ma'i drod mar song*/ lte ba'i rten gyi dwangs ma zhu ba'i dwangs ma rlang pa'i tshul gyis rags pa ma yin par phra la dwangs par sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab dang*/ ro rkyang dbu ma'i nang kun khyab par zhugs pas nye ba zhi ba'i (567) bde bas khyab/ dga' bzhi'i ye shes skye bar bsam/ de nas mas brtan gyi ye shes la'ang bzhi las/ dang po snying ga'i 'od las zer 'phros te lte bar song bas thig le rten dang bcas pa je phra je chung la yar 'dus snying ga'i 'od dang thig le la thim pa'i ngang du bzhag go yang 'od zer mgrin par 'phros je phra la snying gar 'dus pa'i ngang la bzhag yang 'od zer spyi bor thig le rten dang bcas pa la phog pas je phra je chung las snying gar 'dus pa'i ngang la bzhag yang snying ga'i rtsa 'dabs kyi dwangs ma yang rten gyi dwangs ma 'dus/ de yang brten pa thig le (568) sran ma tsam la 'dus 'od lnga bo'ang dbus kyi mthing ka nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang du 'dus/ de yang gdangs je phra las mthar yid la mi phyed pa kun tu bzang mo chos nyid stong pa chen po'i dbyings su dag pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag go de nas kun tu bzang po bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes ni/

de'i tshe lus ri rgyal ltar mi g.yo ba/ ngag lkug pa ltar mi brjod/ sems nam mkha' ltar mi rtog pa'i ngang la bzhag pas/ gang yang yid la mi byed pa'i stong pa ni kun tu bzang mo chos nyid don gyi ye shes la rang gsal dang bcas pa'i rig pa gsal dwangs phyed pa'i snang cha kun tu bzang po chos nyid sku bzhi'i ye shes te/ de (569) gnyis dbyer med dam rig pa phyi nang bar med phyams gdal du gsal ba ni dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med kun bzang yab yum zung 'jug gnyug ma'i ye shes rdzogs pa chen po la mnyam par bzhag go de nas las kyi tshogs sgrub pa ni/ de yang zhi ba'i dus su bla ma rnams sku mdog dkar po las 'od zer 'phros pa'i rtse thams cad las bla ma yi dam gyis nam mkha' gang zhing*/ sngags kyi sgra di ri ri bsgrags pas sngags kyi rang sgras 'jig rten thams cad mer mer khyom khyom 'ur 'ur yod par bsgom pas zhi ba'i dngos grub thob par bsam la/ (570) rtsa sngags dang*/ shin+taṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ btags/ rgyas pa la/ thams cad ser ser bsam la nor dang tshe la sogs pa'i char babs/ rang gi gnas khang dang lus la khyab par bsam la/ puṣ+ṭaṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ btags/ dbang la/ dgug pa la sogs pa dbang gi las la/ thams cad dmar po las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus gang 'dod de drangs nas rkang pa'i 'og tu drangs bar bsam la/ wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ bzhi pa la/ gdon bgegs la sogs pa'i bar chad byung ba na/ thams cad mthing nag las 'od zer mtshon cha'i tshogs 'phros gdon bgegs rdul du byas/ gnas dang (571) nam mkha'i dbyings su me'i 'khor lo rtsibs stong ldan pa bsnol mar 'khor ba'i nang du gnod byed bkug nas dum bu phye mar bsam la/ mā ra ya phaṭa/ btags pa bzla'o/ grub pa rgyun gyi rnal 'byor bshad zin te/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba tshogs la rol zhing dbang bskur ba la/ tshogs bya ba dang*/ dbang bskur ba gnyis las/

dang po tshogs byin gyis brlabs pa/ dbu ba/ rol ba dang gsum las byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ rang gi snying ga nas ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ 'phros gtor tshogs la phog ram̐ gyis bsreg kham̐ gis sbyangs/ yam̐ gis (572)gtor/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las bhan+dha'i snod stong gsum tsam du tshogs kyi yo byad rnams bza' btung bzang dgu ri rab la rgya mtshos bskor ba dang mnyam pa bskyed pa'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i snod bcud dang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bdud rtsi'i char du phab pas khengs te/ sku yi lha mo dkar mo/ gsung gi lha mo dmar po (573)thugs kyi lha mo mthing ka'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phro zhing 'du bar bsam la/ hūm̐/ rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas/ tshogs 'khor sbyang phyir yi ge spro/ ram̐ las me 'bar thams cad bsregs/ kham̐ las chu byung dag par sbyangs/ yam̐ las rlung byung gtor zhing stong*/ bh+rūm̐ las bhan+dha'i gzhal yas khang*/ bdud rtsir gyur nas lha tshogs 'phro/ tshogs mchod (574)yid bzhin sprin du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ga ṇa tsakra te dz+wa ba ling ta ba la ba ti gu h+ya hrī shwa sa ma ye hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā/ hūm̐/ chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas/ skye med bla ma gshegs su gsol/ longs spyod rdzogs sku'i pho brang nas/ gsal dag bla ma gshegs su gsol/ sprul pa sku yi pho brang nas/ thugs rje can rnams gshegs su gsol/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga nas/ (575)bi ma mi tra gshegs su gsol/ pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas/ o rgyan yab yum gshegs su gsol/ 'od phung 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas/ dri med 'od zer gshegs su gsol/ spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng nas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma gshegs su gsol/ 'ja' dang 'od du kyi li li/ sku dang thig le shigs se shig spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan (576)steng du/ bdag dang gnyis med brtan par bzhugs/ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+wam/

phyi nang gsang ba bla na med pa'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ phyi mchod ni/ hūm̐/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'grau'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ ting 'jin dngos bshams dag pas mchod pa ni/ lha mi'i 'jig rten kun nas yid 'ong ba/ lha rdzas dge ba rin chen rnams kyis mchod/ mchod yon zhags bsil me tog bdug spos dang*/ snang gsal dri chab zhal (577)zas rol mo'i sprin/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan bla bre 'phan la sogs/ yid 'ong nam mkha'i dbyings kun bkang ste mchod gzugs sgra dri ro reg dang 'dod yon lnga/ so so'i lha mo sna tshogs sprin 'phro ma/ dpag yas nam mkha'i dbyings kun bkang te 'bul/ thugs rjes bzhes te dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ oṃ badz+ra pū ja me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa (578)sa ma ye hūm̐/ nang mchod/ oṃ/ rang byang ye shes dug lnga sel ba'i sman/ ye shes lnga ldan bdud rtsi amṛ ta/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul/ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa amṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā/ hrīḥ bhan+dha ye shes 'bar ba'i gzhal yas su/ rak+ta dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ rgya mtshor bskyil/ sku lnga ye shes grub pa'i rdzas mchog 'di/ bla ma (579)yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul/ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta pū ja khā hi/ ja gad dpa' bo 'bru bcud phun sum tshogs/ bla med sgrub rdzas mchod pa dam pa 'di/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul/ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa amṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā/ (580)hūm̐/ rje btsun bla ma gshegs su gsol/ gdung ba drag pos gsol ba 'debs/ 'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa 'bul/ rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pa 'bul/ ba ling rgyan gyi mchod pa 'bul/ ting 'jin rtse gcig mchod pa 'bul/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams mchod pa bzhes/ ging gi tshogs rnams mchod pa bzhes/ dpa' bo'i tshogs rnams mchod pa bzhes/

dpa' mo'i tshogs rnams (581)mchod pa bzhes/ srung ma'i tshogs rnams mchod pa bzhes/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa bzhes/ ting 'jin rol mo'i mchod pa bzhes/ chos nyid bde chen mchod pa bzhes/ 'dod yon rgyan g.yi mchod pa bzhes/ spro dga' gnas kyi mchod pa bzhes/ rnal 'byor pho mo dam re gtsang*/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dwang re spro/ dur khrod gnas 'di nyams (582)re dga'/ zhing chen bla re rgyan dang ldan/ gsur chen dud pa dri re zhim/ bam gyi khog stod bcad 'phro ldan/ sha sna snying sna bsam mi khyab/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*/ bde gshegs rgyal ba rgya mtsho mchod/ sna ba snod kyi 'jig rten gtor gzhong du/ srid pa bcud kyi sems can gtor ma sbyar/ dpal gyi gtor ma brjid ldan 'gying ba 'di/ ri rab lhun po bas kyang dpangs re (583)mtho/ ma mo'i gtor ma mtheb kyus bskor ba 'di/ ri rab gling bzhi bas kyang bkod re legs/ dkar gyis thig pa dmar gyis gur phub pa/ gser gyi ri bdun bas kyang brjid re che/ rak+ta dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ sbreng ba 'di/ rgya mtsho mching snam bas kyang rgya re che/ bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa sbreng ba 'di/ lha yi zhal zas bas kyang ro re bda'/ dkar rtsi dmar rtsi sha (584)chen dri chen dang*/ dri chu mchod pa'i rdzas te bdud rtsi lnga/ glang chen khyi dang rma bya rta dang ni/ mchog chen mi la sogs te sha sna lnga/ ma hā māṃ sa la sogs snying sna stong*/ ba su ta dang nang khrol rnam pa lnga/ dbang po lnga dang go ro tsa na dang*/ shing tog me tog 'bru sna sman sna snams/ mngar dang khur ba thug pa'i bye brag (585)dang*/ mar thud phrum dang zho dang 'o ma dang*/ rtsi dang rtsa ru tshi chen go snyod dang*/ sga dang lan tshwa spod kyi rigs rnams dang*/ ri sgog klung sgog sha bal sna tshogs dang*/ ram bu rug pa sha mong sna tshogs dang*/ bza' dang bca' dang b.rung ba'i bye brag dang/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs/

'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa sna tshogs pa/ thogs med (586)blo yi thams cad kun blangs te/ ting 'jin dgongs rgyud dag pas byin rlabs te/ bdud rtsi gyur pa'i gtor ma rgya chen 'di/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul/ rdo rje slob dpon thugs dam bskang gyur cig mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig yi dam lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig dam can srung ma'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig mchod par 'os (587)pa'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig bhan+dhal rak+tas bkang ba yang */ ma dang mkha' 'gro brten phyir 'bul/ tshil chen dud pa btang ba yang*/ ma dang mkha' 'gro brten phyir 'bul/ rak+ta'i rgya mtsho 'khyil ba yang*/ ma dang mkha' 'gro brten phyir 'bul/ zhun chen mar me bltams pa yang*/ ma dang mkha' 'gro brten phyir 'bul/ dam rdzas gtor ma bshams (588)pa yang*/ ma dang mkha' 'gro brten phyir 'bul/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ye shes mkha' 'gro bgyi ba de/ chos rnams chos nyid ma lags sam/ 'khor 'das thams cad mchod par 'bul/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro skad pa de/ sems kyi sems nyid la lags sam/ snang srid thams cad mchod par 'bul/ rin chen mkha' 'gro skad pa de/ sna tshogs sprul sku ma lags sam/ gzung (589)'jin bral ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro skad pa de/ chags med skyon bral ma lags sam/ mnyam nyid rdzogs pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ las kyi mkha' 'gro skad pa de/ las kyi phyag rgya ma lags sam/ phung po lnga yi mchod pa 'bul/ sha za mkha' 'gro skad pa de/ gtor len pho mo ma lags sam/ sha khrag dmar gyi (590)mchod pa 'bul/ oṃ ma hā ba ling ta te dz+wa ba ling ta pū ja la khā hi/

gsang mchod/ āḥ rdo rje pad+ma las byung ba/ thabs dang shes rab byang chub sems/ bde chen ye shes rgyal po che/ yab yum mkha' gsang bde bas mchacod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bo dhi tsit+ta gu h+ya dzñā na ma hā pū ja a hūm̐/ bla med kyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ chos rnams rnam dag rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang*/ mi g.yo byang chub snying (591)po'i mkha' klong du/ snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams ye nas mchod/ bzang ngan blangs dor med pa'i dbyings su bzhais/ mtha' dang dbus med rig pa byang chub sems/ mi 'gyur lhun grub lta ba'i rgyal po mchog kun mnyam yangs pa chen po'i ngang du mchad/ phyogs dang ris med spros dang bral bar bzhes/ 'od gsal dri med ngang dwangs byang chub sems/ rnam par mi rtog (592)sgom pa'i rgyal po mchog bying rgod yengs pa med pa'i klong du mchod/ rang byung gsal 'grib med pa'i ngang du bzhes/ ma 'gags rang shar rig pa byang chub sems/ shar grol ris med spyod pa'i rgyal po mchog sgyu ma rang snang stong gsal klong du mchod/ snang sems rang grol rig pa'i ngang du bzhes/ ye nas lhun rdzogs chos nyid byang chub sems/ rang rig 'od gsal 'bras bu'i rgyal po mchog rang chas thag (593)chod gzhi grol klong du mchod/ gdod ma'i chos nyid kun bzang klong du bzhes/ snang srid chos rnams snang med byang chub sems/ ye stong thig le chen por rnam dag pa/ phyi dang nang med rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang*/ chos nyid don gyi mchod pa bzhes su gsaul/ oṃ āḥm hā shu n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swā bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ tshogs phud phud pa tshogs las sku gsung thugs kyi lha mo spros te/ (594) bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro thams cad mchod par bsam la/ hūm̐/ bla ma rig 'jin ma lus dang*/ yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro dang*/ bcom ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro dpa' bor bcas/ 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro ma lus la/ mjes sdug gzugs kyi mchod pa 'bul/

spyan gyis gzigs shing bzhes su gsol/ a la la ste tshogs la rol/ hūm̐/ bla ma rig 'jin ma lus (595)dang*/ yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro dang*/ bcom ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro dpa' bor bcas/ 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro ma lus la/ dbyangs snyan sgra yi mchod pa 'bul/ snyan gyis gsan cing bzhes su gsol/ a la la ste tshogs la rol/ hūm̐/ bla ma rig 'jin ma lus dang*/ yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro dang*/ bcom ldan rdo rje (596)rnal 'byor ma/ rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro dpa' bor bcas/ 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro ma lus la/ bda' dgu dri yi mchod pa 'bul/ shangs kyi bsnams shing bzhes su gsol/ a la la ste tshogs la rol/ hūm̐/ bla ma rig 'jin ma lus dang*/ yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro dang*/ bcom ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro dpa' bor bcas/ 'khor gyi mkha' (597)'grau ma lus la/ bza' btung ro yi mchod pa 'bul/ ljags kyis myong zhing bzhes su gsol/ a la la ste tshogs la rol/ hūm̐/ bla ma rig 'jin ma lus dang*/ yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro dang*/ bcom ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro dpa' bor bcas/ 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro ma lus la/ bzang dgu reg gi mchod pa 'bul/ sku yi (598)mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ a la la ste tshogs la rol/ hūm̐/ bla ma rig 'jin ma lus dang*/ yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro dang*/ bcom ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro dpa' bor bcas/ 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro ma lus la/ spros bral chos kyi mchod pa 'bul/ thugs kyis dgongs shing bzhes su gsol/ a la (599)la ste tshogs la rol/ dpa' bo dpa' mo mched lcam la/ zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul/ gnyis med rol nas bzhes su gsol/ a la la ste tshogs la rol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru de wa ḍāk+ki ni ma hā ga ṇa tsakra kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis 'bul/ bshags pa la thal mo sbyar te/

oṃ/ gdod nas rnam dag kun tu bzang mo'i klong*/ (600)yon tan 'bum phrag yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kun/ 'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs shing bzhugs su gsaul/ thams cad lhun grub bde chen sangs rgyas shing*/ mkha' ltar rnam dag spros bral ba la/ ma rig dbang gis nga dang bdag tu bzung*/ chos nyid don dang 'gal ba mthol lo bshags/ rang snang lhun grub rig pa'i gzhal (601)yas 'dir/ ting 'jin dngos su bshams pa'i mchod sprin gyis/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang*/ nyams chag bskang nas dngos grub stsal du gsol/ bdag med spros bral gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ rdo rje mchog gsum sgrub par dam mnos kyang*/ sku gsung thugs dang mnyam sbyor sdom pa'i mchog rtsa ba yan lag (602)chag nyams mthal lo bshags/ zhing gyur dam pa mchog gsum spyan lam du/ phyi nang gsang ba'i tshogs mchod rgya mtsho bshams/ da lta rgyu mchog dam pa 'dis bskang bas/ nyams chags bskang nas dngaso grub stsal du gsol/ mi g.yo rdo rje snying po'i pho brang du/ kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod byas te/ g.yar dam blangs kyang de ltar rngo ma thogs/ phyi nang mchod tshogs (603)chung ba mthol lo bshags/ rab 'byams yon tan rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor du/ bstod dbyangs mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i skong rdzas 'dis/ rdau rje rgyal po sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ nyams chags bskang nas dngos grub stsal du gsol/ gsang sngags rda rje mchog gsum dkyil 'khor 'dir/ dbang dang dam tshig 'jug sgo gcig pa la/ bla ma smod cing mchod la khros pa (604)dang*/ gsang sgo 'chol ba'i nyes kun mthol lo bshags/ dkyil 'khor mchog gsum tshul bzhin mchod byas te/ ting 'jin bsnyen sgrub dam pa bcas pa 'dis/ bla ma yi dam thugs dam bskang gyur nas/ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ dad ldan bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po dang*/

tshogs mchod mchod sbyin rdzas la spyod gyur pas/ 'dre bkren yi dwags skye (605)ba'i rgyur gyur pa/ 'gal 'khrul nyams chags thams cad mthol lo bshags/ rgyal mchod sems can yul du sbyin byas shing*/ bsod nams bya ba'i lam dang 'brel gyur pa/ byang chub snying po'i lam du rab bskang bas/ nyams chags bskang nas dngos grub stsal du gsol/ dus rnams kun tu bsgrub par dam bcas kyang*/ le lo rkyen dbang tshe 'di'i dbang song (606)bas/ bsnyen sgrub g.yel zhing thun bzhi dus las yol/ sgrub pa'i dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ chos dbyings byang chub brdal ba'i mkha' nyid du/ bskyed rdzogs rang bzhin mos pas ci nus spyod/ rnam gsum dge la bskul zhing bskang ba yis/ nyams chags bskang nas dngos grub stsal du gsol/ chos rnams rang bzhin dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ snang (607)grags dran rig sku gsung thugs nyid du/ shes dang mi spangs spyad dang dang du blangs/ nyi shu rtsa brgyad nyams chag mthol lo bshags/ phyi nyang rtog pa dag pa'i bdag nyid can/ lta sgom spyod 'bras nyams su blangs po 'tshal/ nyinamatshan ting 'jin dgongs klong bskang ba yis/ nyams chag bskang nas dngos grub stsal du gsol/ 'od gsal thig le chen po'i dkyil (608)'khor du/ ngang dwangs rang bzhin bdag nyid mi 'bral bas/ dgongs spyod rgya mtsho 'du 'bral med rgyu las/ bying rgod sdig la 'chol ba mthol lo bshags/ chos rnams rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang*/ 'khor 'das ming tsam sgyu mar rang shes la/ rang grol gdod ma'i dbyings su bskangs pa des/ khams gsum yongs sgrol kun bzang dngos grub stsol/ zhes yi ge brgya pa brjod do/ tshogs la rol (609) ba ni/ las kyi karma ging gis phyag rgyas tshogs btegs te/ gzigs shig mjes ldan dam pa'i chos/ 'di la the tshom byar mi rung*/ bram ze khyi dang gdol ba phag rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol/

dngos grub thams cad 'di las 'byung*/ skyogs kyi nang na bhan+dha bzang*/ skom gyi nang na bdud rtsi mchog skyogs kyi nang na ka pā la/ zas ni sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ ma mo (610)mkha' 'gro'i longs spyod yin/ rnal 'byor pho mo'i dngos grub zas/ a la la ste tshogs la rol/ zhes drangs pa'i lan du/ len pa sos sad skor gyi phyag rgya bcas/ oṃ/ bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku/ 'dod chags la sogs dri ma bral/ gzung 'jin rnam par spangs pa yi/ de bzhin nyid la dgus phyag 'tshal/ a la la ste sku yi mchog sku yi dngos grub 'gyur ba med/ a la la ste gsung gi mchog (611)gsung gi dngos grub 'gags pa med/ a la la ste thugs kyi mchog thugs kyi dngos grub skye ba med/ sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/ a ho ma hā su kha hoḥ zhes brjod pas blangs te/ rang gi mgo dang mgrin pa bla ma'i dkyil 'khor/ snying khar yi dam/ lte bar mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du bsam la/ bza' btung bdud rtsir gyur pa zos shing 'thung bas bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro thams cad mchod par bsam zhing tshim par longs spyod/ (612) thams cad lha'i dkyil 'khor gyi ngang las ma g.yos par bya zhing tha mal gyi snang ba dang*/ shag dang rtsod pa dang*/ ku co la sogs pa mi bya'o/ de nas lhag ma rnams bsdus la phyogs gcig tu bzhag go de nas gnyis pa dbang blang ba ni/ dkyil 'khor 'og ma ltar spros bcas byis pa nyer spyod gyi dbang las ches khyad du 'phags pa/ byin rlabs don gyi rim pa tshig dbang rin po che dbang bzhi brda don du blang ba la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes dang gsum las/ sngon 'gro la lnga las/ khrus dang maṇ+ḍal sngon du sogs nas/ dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na mo/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*/ bla ma (613)yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*/ lta sgom spyod pa ma lus la/ phyi nang gsang bar skyabs su mchi/ zhes lan gsum brjod do/
