gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ e ma bdag dang sems can rnams/ ye nas rnam dag sangs rgyas chos/ ma rtogs 'khrul pa'i 'khor ba rnams/ srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral bar bya/ oṃ ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta rat+na sa twa na ma zhes brjod/ gsum pa yan lag bdun pa ni/ (614)oṃ/ bde gshegs ma lus 'dus pa'i sku/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la/ zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi/ lus btud gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ rnam dag 'dod yon lnga la sogs/ dngos dang yid kyis sprul pa yi/ mchod pa dam pa thams cad kun/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gror mchod/ tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas/ da lta'i lus 'di yan chad la/ sdig pa mi dge ci bgyis pa/ (615)bla ma sangs rgyas rnams la bshags/ 'gro ba sems can don slad du/ bskal pa du mar mi skyo bar/ byang chub spyod pa sna tshogs kyis/ dge ba mjad la rjes yi rang*/ spyod dang rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs kyis/ sems can kun la phan don du/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' la/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ gang dag mya ngan 'da' rnams la/ (616)ji srid 'khor ba ma stong bar/ mtha' yas sems can don gyi phyir/ mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba 'debs/ bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyis/ byas dang byed 'gyur gzhan bskul ba'i/ dge bas mtha' yas sems can rnams/ kun mkhyen sangs rgyas thob par shog zhes lan gsum brjod/ bzhi pa khyad par gyi sems ye shes su bskyed pa ni/ e ma ho/ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/ (617)ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la/ yin par shes pa'i bdag nyid du/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ zhes lan gsum/ lnga pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dbang thob par byed pa la sngon du gsol ba 'debs pa ni gal che bas/ dad gus rab dang ldan pas mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma mkha' 'gro bzhugs pa la dmigs te/ bla ma rdo rje 'jin pa ni/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnyen gcig pu/ 'gro ba mgon med rnams (618)kyi skyabs/

thar ba'i lam skas chen po ste/ ma rig sel ba'i sgron me la/ mun pa'i tshogs bdag skyabs su mchi/ 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du/ bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyob/ nyon mongs me yi gdung ba la/ thugs rje'i char gyis bsil bar mjod/ thugs kyi dkyil 'khor bzang po 'dir/ bdag ni yang dag gzhung tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ de nas rang nyid pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar mo (619)snying gar 'od kyi thig le me long tsam la ha ri ni sas mtshan par bsam la/ rtsa sngags dang*/ hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrīḥya tsit+ta hrīṃ hrīṃ ja jaḥ zhes/ jab dbyangs bzlas pas byin phebs so/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba ni/ spyi bor gtor ma btegs nas/ gtor ma lha'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa rang gi spyi bor byon pas lha rnams kyi dbu'i gtsug gi oṃ dkar po las 'od zer 'phros rang rang gi lus la phog (620)pas lus kyi sgrib pa dag sku'i dngos grub bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun babs pas lus khengs bum pa'i dbang thob/ dbang rtags su spyi bor oṃ dkar pos mtshan par bsam la/ e ma ho/ ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i dbang*/ bla ma rnams dang gcig pa dang*/ yi dam lha dang dbyer med dang*/ mkha' 'gros byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyir/ dam rdzas gtor mas dbang bskur bas/ rtsa ba gsum gyi byin (621)rlabs kyis/ sku yi byin rlabs lus la zhugs/ lus kyi sgrib pa byang nas ni/ sku mi 'gyur tshe yi dbang thob shog oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru de wa dz+wa ki ḍā ki ni kā ya ba ling ta a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ oṃ oṃ/ yang*/ lha rnams kyi mgrin pa'i āḥdamar po las 'od 'phros rang gi mgrin par phog ngag gi sgrib pa dag gsung gi dngos grub bdud rtsi dmar po'i rgyun babs lus (622)khengs gsang ba'i dbang thob/ dbang rtags su mgrin par āḥdamar pos mtshan par bsam la/ e ma ho/ ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i dbang*/ bla ma rnams dang gcig pa dang*/

yi dam lha dang dbyer med dang*/ mkha' 'gros byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyir/ dam rdzas gtor mas dbang bskur bas/ ngag gi sgrib pa byang nas ni/ rtsa ba gsum gyi byin rlabs kyis/ gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la zhugs/ gsung snying po lung gi (623)dbang thob shog oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru de wa dz+wa ki ḍa ki ni wāka ba ling ta a bhi ṣiñtsa a a āḥ yang*/ lha rnams kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ mthing ka las 'od zer 'phros rang gi snying gar phog yid kyi sgrib pa dag thugs kyi dngos grub bdud rtsi sngon po'i rgyun babs pas lus khengs shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ dbang rtags su snying khar hūm̐ mthing gis mtshan par bsam la/ e ma ho/ (624)ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i dbang*/ bla ma rnams dang gcig pa dang*/ yi dam lha dang dbyer med dang*/ mkha' 'gros bayin gyis brlabs pa'i phyir/ dam rdzas gtor mas dbang bskur bas/ rtsa ba gsum gyi byin rlabs kyis/ thugs kyi byin rlabs yid la zhugs/ sems kyi sgrib pa byang nas ni/ thugs skye med rdo rje'i dbang thob shog oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru de wa dz+wa ki ḍā ki ni tsit+ta ba ling ta a (625)bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ dbang bzhi pa ni thams cad hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes dbyangs dang bcas pas byin 'ur gyis ba phebs par du brjod/

phaṭa ces drag por brjod nas lus sems khong glod pa'i ngang nas/ hūm̐/ rang byung rig pa don gyi dbang*/ sal le seng nge 'ol le ba/ stong gsal ston ka'i nam mkha' bzhin/ chos sku nyag gcig don gyi dbang*/ zhes 'di nyid rang chas yang ya'i sangs rgyas yin pas/ rang ngo shes thog tu bzhag pa las/ 'di'i ngang na 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad med (626) snang sgyu ma tsam du skye 'gags gnas gsum ltar snang dus nyid nas med par la zlos ni rig pa rtsal gyi dbang ngo*/ de ltar na dbang dang po gsum gyis snang bcas thabs bskyed pa'i rim pa gzugs sku sgyu ma lta bu'i don bsgom pa la dbang*/ bzhi pas snang med shes rab gyi rim pa rdzogs rim nam mkha' lta bu sgom pa la dbang ba dang*/ chos sku dam pa thob pa'i rgyu byed pas na dbang zhes bya'o/ rjes kyi bya ba la bcu/ lung 'bog pa sngar bskyed pa'i/ bla ma yi (627)dam mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor gsal btab la thams cad jab dbyangs bzlas par dmigs te/ rtsa sngags dang*/ hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ/ zhes sngon la ring bo/ bar du 'bring po/ rjes la thung ngur brjod la/ dkyil 'khor thams cad rim gyis gtso bo'i thugs kar bsdus la mthar mi dmigs par bzhag go lha mchod pa ni/ gtor ma'i dkyil 'khor rang gi snying gar thim/ gtor ma lha yi zhal zas (628)'dod yon gyi lha mos brgyan par bsam la/ rtsa ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar bsam la gtor ma phul te/ rtsa sngags la/ hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum phul bas mnyes nas sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob par bsam la bstod pa ci rigs pas bstod/ de nas dngos grub blang ba ni/ gtor ma de mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub kyi rdzas lha'i bdud rtsi 'dod yon lnga'i rang bzhin zos pa tsam gyis nad zhi (629)ba gdon zhi ba rkyen ngan dang bar chad zhi ba/

tshe ring ba nad med pa/ longs spyod 'phel ba/ ci bsam 'grub pa/ mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi byang chub thob par bsam la thod chung hub re dang mnyam du rol bas de ltar thob po/ de nas lhag ma'i gtor ma btang ba ni/ sngar gyi lhag ma'i steng du gtor ma spungs/ mar me gcig bzhag ste/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis kha chu bdud rtsir bsam pas bran te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā pañtsa amṛ ta ba ling ta kha kha khā hi (630)khā hi/ lhag ma'i tshogs kyi skal ba la dbang ba'i/ mkha' 'gro ging dang dregs pa sde brgyad bcas/ lhag ma'i mchod gtor bzang pa 'di snoms la/ bcol ba'i phrin las ma lus grub par mjod/ ces brjod la btang ngo*/ brtan ma skyong ba ni/ lhag gtor gyi rjes su/ hūm̐/ bka' yi tshogs dang bcas nyid du/ khrag 'thung de bzhin nam mkha'i sku/ tshur gshegs tshur gshegs skyong ma rnams/ (631)'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gyi gtor ma bzhes/ bdag nyid chen mo la sogs bdud mo bzhi/ gangs dkar sha med la sogs gnod sbyin bzhi kong btsun de mo la sogs sman mo bzhi/ bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis po/ rin chen lhab lhub mang po'i rgyan dang bcas/ pho nya bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcas/ mchod dang gtor ma dam pa 'di bzhes la/ bcol (632)ba'i phrin las ma lus grub par mjod/ hūm̐/ brtan ma chen mo khyed rnams la/ slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng gis/ rgya yul de ni gdan bzang na/ a su ra yi phrag phug tu/ rnam lnga zhing gi mchod bshams nas/ zhing chen sgrol ba'i gdan steng du/ dmar chen bhan+dha'i mchod bshams nas/ lag tu rdo rje gtad nas kyang*/ rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i grogs kyis zhes/ thar ba thob pa'i ming btags ste/ bran gyi tshul du (633)khas blangs ma/ dam tshig de las khyed ma 'da'/ dam tshig de las khyed 'da' na/ badz+ra yak+sha khro bo yi/ snying gi dkyil nas khrag drangs te/ 'o dado 'bod par gdon mi za/ de bas bod khams skyong ma'i tshogs/

sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la/ bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mjod/ la lā/ li lī/ tang tang*/ te te/ rdo rje sring 'gro ma hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ de nas (634) gtor gzhung bkrus pa sgo khar sbubs la gnod byed mnan par bsam la/ hūm̐/ sngon tshe dpa chen he ru kas/ kun tu bzang mo'i mkha' dbyings su/ khams gsum yongs sgrol mjad pa'i tshe/ dpal gyi bre chen brdung ba ltar/ 'bar ba'i rnal 'byor sngags 'chang bdag dbang chen 'bar ba'i gzhal yas 'dir/ rol ba'i bro chen chems se chem/ hūm̐ gis dbang bsgyur khams gsum g.yo/ phaṭa kyi (635)'phro 'dus 'jig rten 'khyom/ ram̐ gyis mi 'bar thams cad bsregs/ rkang ba g.yas pa thabs kyi rgyas/ 'khor ba chos nyid rol bar mnan/ rkang ba g.yon pa shes rab rgyas/ mya ngan 'das pa dbyings su mnan/ gzung 'jin 'khor ba'i phung po la/ gnyis med ye shes bro brdung bas/ thams cad rang byung ye shes ngang*/ srid gsum ye nas grol bar mnan/ dug lnga (636)'dus pa'i phung po la/ ye shes lnga yi bro brdung bas/ nyon mongs rnam dag ye shes ngang*/ rang bzhin 'od gsal chen por mnan/ snang srid snod bcud snang ba la/ dkyil 'khor chen por brdung bas/ thams cad 'og min gzhal yas khang*/ ye rdzogs lhun gyi grub par mnan/ dbang chen gar gyi dkyil 'khor du/ bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i bro brdung bas/ dgra bgegs chos nyid bskal bar mnan/ (637)zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las rdzogs/ oṃ nan/ laṃ nan/ s+t+wam bha ya nan/ zhes brjod/ de nas dkyil 'khor mchod de nongs pa bshags pa ni/ na mo/ blal ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du/ tshul bzhin mchod kyang 'gal 'khrul nyes gyur pa/ gang lags de kun bzod par bzhes nas kyang*/ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes yi ge brgya pa brjod/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ (638)oṃ/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kun/ rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsal nas kyang*/

rang gnas dge ba byang chub gnas gshegs te/ slar yang thugs rjes 'byon par mjad du gsol/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod nas/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ ye shes pa dbyings su gsegs/ de nas bsngo ba ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhags pa'i bla ma dang*/ yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi (639)lha tshogs thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor mchod cing bsnyen sgrub spyad pa dang*/ tshogs kyis bskang zhing dbang bskur ba la sogs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di la brten nas/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad/ rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i don mngon du gyur nas 'bad pa dang rtsol ba med par lus dang yid kyi bya (640)ba dang*/ brjod pa dang*/ sems pa dang*/ snang ba thams cad chos nyid kyi 'khor lo shar te/ rgyun gyi ting nge 'jin dang*/ mi brjed pa'i gzungs dang*/ thogs pa med pa'i shes rab dang*/ rnam par grol ba'i ye shes dang*/ chu bo lta bu'i spobs pa dang*/ rdo rje lta bu'i tshe dang*/ lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las dang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs dang*/ dpag tu med pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang*/ zad mi shes pa'i chos (641)kyi mjod dam par dbang bsgyur bar gyur cig de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi gsang ba bla na med pa'i dgongs pa mngon du gyur nas/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor du sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i dbyings la snang ba bzhi yi don mthar phyin te skye ba dang*/ 'jug pa la dbang bas 'pho ba chen po'i (642)go 'phang 'grub par gyur cig de nas bkra shis brjod pa/ mdun gyi rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis dgongs shing bkra shis pa'i tshig brjod pa dang chab gcig me tog gi char chen po bsnyil bar bsam la/ a ho/ bkra shis dpal du 'bar ba'i lha/ mchog gsum bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ bkra shis rin chen char 'bebs pa'i/ phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis shog

gnas 'di gang snang sangs rgyas (643)zhing*/ rang snang rig pa'i zhing khams la/ ye nas 'og min chos kyi dbyings/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis shog mgon 'di chos rje rin po che/ 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal du shar/ ye nas rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul mgon/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis shog 'khor 'di skal ldan dad dang ldan/ thar lam (644)sgrub pa snying por byed/ ye nas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yi/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis shog chos 'di theg pa kun gyi rtse/ mchog tu gsang ba bla na med/ ye nas rdzogs pa chen po'i klong*/ chos phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis shog dus 'di chos nyid 'pho 'gyur med/ rtag pa rgyun gyi 'khor lo'i gzhi/ ye nas dus bzhi mnyam pa nyid/ dus phun sum (645)tshogs pa'i bkra shis shog slar smras pa/ zhing 'di mjes pa'i mgon po ji snyed dang*/ ngo mtshar spyod pa dpa' ba'i sems dpa'i tshogs/ mgon po khyod las gzhan du rgyal bas kyang*/ gzigs pa med na bdag blos ji ltar 'tshal/ de slad bsod nams bye ba'i gter chen mjod/ bla ma'i zhing bzang nyes pa ma sbags pa/ dge ba'i byang chub ljon pa'i gzhi lags pas/ 'badapa'i sems kyis bya ba'i sa bon bskyed/ zhi bsil rin chen char gyi rgyun chen pos/ sa gsum skye dgu'i tha rgod nem byas nas/ byang chub myu gu (646) gsar ba gong 'phel nas/ rnam mkhyen 'bras bu'i dga' ston rgyas gyur cig ces bla ma mchod pa'i rim pa 'di nyid snga sor nas mchog gzigs sprul pa'i sku kun tu bzang po bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan nas/ sems nyid ngal gso'i don khrid kyi dgongs pa'i don ltar bla ma'i dus dran gyi cho ga zhig bgyi bar bkas bskul na'ang*/ de kar sgom las su gyur pa dang*/ slar yang rig 'jin bla ma dam pa'i thugs kyi sras re khe'i phyogs kyi sgrub brtson bla ma dam pa dbang chen dang*/ dkon mchog bstan 'jin zung gi bkas bskur ma lan mang du son pa don yod par bya ba'i phyir/

tshul khrims rgya mtshos dpal yul brda go lha ri 'od gsal (647) (648) gling gi ri khrod du/ kun mkhyen chen po'i gsung rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso'i rtsa 'grel dang*/ don khrid kyi dgongs pa'i don bzhin kun mkhyen chen po'i gsung gung bsgrigs te bkod pa'i dge bas sems can thams cad rig 'jin bla ma dam pa'i go 'phang la 'god pa'i rgyur gyur cig maṅga lam/// /
